playajazzcafe.description: A celebration of Jazz Music featuring nightly concerts and jam sessions, daytime educational workshops, and a lively bar serving coffee and cocktails.

Write, doodle, or read the journals lying all around, filled with the stories of visitors from past burns. Eat a pancake at our morning disco party. Pilgrimage with us to deep playa at sunrise for tea and tunes. Get some deep rest in our meditative sound bath or simply lounge and connect with fellow travelers < 3

cuttlefishhomebase.description: Hometown: Santa Rosa Come find the Cuttlefish (and Flash the Tortoise) back at their lair and say hi! Contact

apotheneum.description: Apo-the-neum (place of divine elevation) is a visual, sonic and haptic instrument intended to "transport" visitors through participatory immersion. Comprised of two nested chambers made of back-to-back LED nets (13,940 nodes in all), Apotheneum presents multiple canvases for collaborating visual artists and an immersive sound system for collaborating sound artists. Measuring 40 x 40 x 40 feet, Apo

shittest.name: The Shittest Camp
shittest.description: Hometown: New York City Our camp celebrates one of the most universal human experiences: poop. Through humor, art, and playful activities, we aim to normalize conversations around bodily functions and remind everyone that we all share the same basic human needs. Our camp features a toilet-themed bar, a quirky camp museum, and a variety of interactive activities including DJ sets, comedy, scavenger

adramanation.name: AdramaNation
adramanation.description: AdramaNation is an all inclusive and diverse camp focusing on a drama free and fun filled burn. Engaging workshops, delicious delicacies, hydration, art, weddings, burnercise, and good company are to be found with us. Whether you need a safe space to escape your drama or a place to meet new friends, you're always welcome here.

dontstop.name: Don't STOP
dontstop.description: Black Rock City is a place where small things can derail your day or night and we want to support our fellow burners by offering small necessities [ex. tampons, condoms, sunscreen, or glowy things] from our Don't Stop Gift Box, or a drink with inspired conversation. Additionally, we offer opportunities to restore through Yoga and breathwork and learn how to repair your bike.

kombuchachacha.name: Kombuchachacha
kombuchachacha.description: Kombucha: (n) kom-BOO-cha. Renowned playa aphrodisiac. You may not get the booch you want but you will definitely get the booch you need. The home of con+sent. Relax, refresh and cha cha the day away. 4 stars on yelp 2024.

cuddleoasis.name: Cuddle Oasis
cuddleoasis.description: Too hot? Too Cold? Partied out? Need a break? Need a cuddle or two? or Ten? You have come to the right place! Come relax under our many shade structures. Enjoy afternoon Sound baths. Follow the large lighted Palm trees at night and come enjoy a drink at the bar and ask about our daily activities that vary each day.

unstable.name: UnStable
unstable.description: We are a Mutant vehicle Support Camp for an MV named "Chester." We will be sharing resources and supporting an art support camp called, "Apotheneum." They are a large scale interactive light and sound installation.

wonder.name: Wonder Camp
wonder.description: The Department of Wonder is our on-playa bike shop. We offer bike repair service and education every day of the event through man-burn. We will be offering a workshop around fixing and maintaining bikes in playa specific conditions.

surge.name: The Surge
surge.description: Come charge your small devices at THE SURGE's bar or living room. Join us for cold-brew coffee, meditation, education, conversation in our comfortable living room with a water mister, or grab a tasty brew or shot (or NA wine) at our fabulous bar. Join us for our Cancer Survivor circle on Tuesday and/or Thursday mornings.

naacb.name: Naacb
naacb.description: NAACB (National Association for the Advancement of Colored Burners)

powderpalace.name: Powder Palace
powderpalace.description: Bringing a winter chill to the Playa and looking forward to sharing some of our winter delights. Come by for snowshoe races and our apres-ski dance party!

blackrocksocks.name: Black Rock Socks
blackrocksocks.description: Creating customized socks for the burn made and designed with love. Join us for some whacky events or just stop by to say hi

karmalove.name: Karma Love Camp
karmalove.description: Karma Love Camp is a welcoming oasis designed for connection, relaxation, and playful interaction. We offer body art, wellness experiences, dance, gifting, and a friendly space to simply be. Our camp is a chill rest stop where you can relax, recharge, and connect with new friends. Whether you're looking to join a fun event or just hang out and chat, Karma Love Camp is here to share joy and genuine

dunedwellers.name: Dune Dwellers
dunedwellers.description: Mutant Vehicle Support Camp for The Wandering Playhouse

dilatedpeoples.name: Dilated Peoples
dilatedpeoples.description: Expand your inner-vision while indulging your senses. A soothing treatment of refreshing eye drops, cucumber slices, a cooling eye mask, gentle mist, healing touch, and lavender pillow awaits you within an enchanting oasis.

altitudelounge.name: Altitude Lounge
altitudelounge.description: Come lounge on our tower overlooking the playa and see what you helped create while enjoying our down-tempo beats at sunset!

bearwhalea.name: Bearwhalea
bearwhalea.description: They frame the wildest theories upon the most irrelevant facts, or upon the merest fancies. Mr. Darwin thinks that whales may be bears which have enormously increased their bulk, washed their paws into fins by constant swimming, and stretched their mouths by keeping them open to catch insects in the water. revolution.name: rEVOLUTION
revolution.hometown: Los Angeles, Amsterdam, Finland, Costa Rica
revolution.description: rEVOLUTION is both a high energy camp and a chill camp. We believe that through evolution, we can create a revolution. We reserve the right to change, to be agents of change and to commit to the Burning Man principles each time we return after our revolution around the sun. We offer food, beverages, healing through Gamma Breath Work, opportunities to communicate with anyone and fun through dance.

magiclanternsociety.name: Magic Lantern Society
magiclanternsociety.description: The Magic Lantern is a wandering inn, located at the end of all worlds. Sumptuously-appointed with antiques, curiosities, games, and mysterious old books, we are a space created for deeper human connection, and a warm and inviting sanctuary for the weary and curious traveller. Our centerpiece is our unique Trading Booth, where stories and secrets are the only accepted currency. Anyone can step up

studioandspa.name: Studio and Spa
studioandspa.description: Come to BRC Studio and Spa to not only to receive a massage or have your sensual, erotic or daring fine-art photo taken, but join one of our workshops and take some new skill back to the default word. Either way, walk away with a unique photo print, or a new skill, or at least relaxed!

xpatalien.name: Xpat Alien
xpatalien.description: Xpat Alien has searched far and wide, through many galaxies, to find a new place to rest our travel weary heads. Earth fits the bill and we have decided to stay. hakunamatata.name: Hakuna Matata
hakunamatata.description: Building art objects and art cars to light up the Playa Nocturnal Kaleidoscope! Promoting mindful and safe cruising. SLOW DOWN!!! Leave No Trace )'(

servantsofthesecretfire.description: Servants of the Secret Fire have been bringing dazzling LED and fire art to playa while hosting fire spinning jams and flow workshops since 2015. bonevoyage.name: Bone Voyage
bonevoyage.description: Hometown: Walnut Creek Welcome to the official backstage hub for the Bone Voyage mutant vehicle! sunrisetavern.name: Sunrise Tavern

starjelly.name: Star Jelly
starjelly.description: Star jelly is a loosely knit collection of individuals operating as a singular organism. Traveling space and time to learn and share with you all at Burning Man. picklebackoasis.name: Pickleback Oasis

vwbus.description: Want to participate at Tomorrow Today driving to the Playa in an old VW Bus or other unique camper? bloodandsugar.name: Blood & Sugar

kinkypizza.description: Hot slices, Hot flogging, and Hot fire. It's only kinky the first time...

itastepurple.description: Step into a world where a psychedelic dream meets a desert carnival. kampkit.name: Kamp Kit
kampkit.description: We specialize only in infused liquor shots, infusing all the flavors ourselves. Some are delicious. Some are too hot to handle. Some are pretty gross. No mixers, no chasers! cognitiveresearchinstitute.name: Cognitive Research Institute
cognitiveresearchinstitute.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Santa Cruz Would you like a quick memory screening? We can help you make sure you’ll actually remember this week. somecamp.name: Some Camp!
somecamp.description: It's a food bank AND a cinema! Pop by, tell us your tale of woe, and replace your lost food. Vegan and keto available while supplies last. Grab some popcorn and stay for a movie after the sun goes down. Bring us your extra supplies for redistribution.

shenanigans.name: Shenanigans
shenanigans.description: ICE COLD face masks! Find us when the sun is high and the heat is excessive every day. stoopcity.description: Stoop City captures the magic of a fever dream spent wandering the streets of Black Rock City. This might just be the late night corner bodega you never knew you needed.

parliamentartcrew.name: Parliament Art Crew
parliamentartcrew.description: We're the Art Support Camp that has brought in the past these art installations for the delight of our community: COQUÍ, Atabey's Treasure, MÚCARO and Got Framed.

cerealthrillers.name: Cereal Thrillers
cerealthrillers.description: Breakfast cereal bar where we serve that sugary cereal your Mom didn't let you have as a kid

cosplaycentral.name: Cosplay Central

dustynutstavern.name: The Dusty Nuts Tavern
dustynutstavern.description: Escape the constant wub wub for something a little different, along with dusty drinks from dusty people.

takeelyaortahealya.name: ta-keel-ya or ta-heal-ya
takeelyaortahealya.description: Hometown: San Diego A glowing pink disco dome invites passersby to pause and choose their own adventure! phocureburn.description: PhoCureBurn is a Vietnamese-inspired café serving comfort food to the citizens of Black Rock City. Our goal is to create a welcoming space where burners can connect, share stories, and form lasting memories—whether over an iced (!!) coffee or a steaming bowl of pho.

pandorasloungeandfixitshoppe.name: Pandora's Lounge & Fix-it Shoppe
pandorasloungeandfixitshoppe.description: Our camp keeps our fellow Burners biking: our repair shop offers education, tools and parts, for bike repair. diceysidequests.name: Dicey Side Quests
diceysidequests.description: Dicey Side Quests is a new camp that provides Black Rock Citizens with intimate gaming experiences and connection, guided by passionate gamers of all backgrounds! maybeyoushouldtalktosomeone.name: Maybe You Should Talk To Someone
maybeyoushouldtalktosomeone.description: Our camp provides on-playa counseling services, offering burners a space to process emotions, navigate conflicts, and reconnect with their experience in a meaningful way. skinnykittyteahouse.name: Skinny Kitty Teahouse
skinnykittyteahouse.description: The best big, fat, kitty-loving teahouse on the playa. Come get some shade, couches and tea, tea, tea 24/7. If you come at the right time you might catch a performance, a wandering piano player tickling the keys, some aerialists, fire spinners or just some fabulous conversation at the tea bar.

galacticcruzaders.name: Galactic Cruzaders
galacticcruzaders.description: A JOURNEY OF TIME AND SPACE Galactic Cruzaders - the true international camp bringing in folks from all over the world. Stop by for Wednesday Night cocktails in formal attire. Sit your ass down and get warm around the camp fire on every night. And stop by and listen to what our DJ's are spining, or join in with the live band when they play.

mudskippers.name: Mudskippers

onlymembers.name: Only mEmbers
onlymembers.description: "Only mEmbers" bar (21 and over). Only VIPs with proof of membership are permitted. Absolutely no exceptions.

childrenofchaos.name: Children of Chaos

spectaters.name: Spec-Taters
spectaters.description: And amidst this sea of humanity, there are potatoes. Yes, potatoes. Perhaps an unexpected sight in the midst of such a surreal landscape, but therein lies the magic of Burning Man. These humble tubers, often overlooked in daily life, take on new significance here. They're not just food; they're symbols of sustenance, resilience, and community.

nodrama.name: No Drama Camp
nodrama.description: We are all inclusive Camp that provides the Citizens of Black Rock City with a fun and interesting place to stop by for a Drink at our No Drama Bar. We host many daily events under our large shade structure. Nightly DJ's play music for those stopping by on their way around the Playa. insomnophilia.description: Insomnophilia is back at it in 2024 to celebrate being awake with YOU! soundcloud.description: Welcome to the SoundCloud. Your cloud-themed portal to high-vibe frequencies and dreamy beats. Float with us through ambient bliss, deep grooves, and healing vibrations on the fluffiest clouds in the multiverse. orangeheart.description: We are a fourth year theme camp - Camp Orange Heart. Our camp is founded on the principles of unconditional love, mutual respect, honesty, trust, and transparency. acornoasis.description: Are you as nuts about Squirrels as we are?! If these mischievous charmers and their playful antics bring you joy, then scurry over to Acorn Oasis! secondwindpiratecafe.description: Embark on a nocturnal adventure at the Second Wind Pirate Café, a vibrant pirate-themed coffee spot that only opens its doors from 9 PM until about 1 AM. blackrocksaunasociety.name: Black Rock Sauna Society
blackrocksaunasociety.description: Experience the essence of Finnish sauna culture amidst the Playa's embrace. leopardmartinilounge.name: Leopard Martini Lounge
leopardmartinilounge.description: The LEOPARD MARTINI LOUNGE has been returning since 1998 serving top shelf cocktails in a chill area with wonderful people. laststarfighters.name: The Last Starfighters
laststarfighters.description: Greetings, Starfighter. You have been recruited by the Star League to defend the playa against commodification & moop. fafa.description: Welcome! We are an international camp and look forward to seeing you at our friendly, cozy camp. Come round mornings and afternoons for our interactivities or to just sit in the shade on our front porch.

g.description: Welcome to our living room, g. Grab a croissant and dance for an hour or ten. We're grateful you're here.

brandurassnmore.name: Brand-Ur-Ass N More

hotshots.description: Our camp is a tiny haven for those looking to immerse themselves in the beauty of the desert, fostering moments of connection and self-discovery via our golden hour photo shoots and late night treats. ofosho.name: Ofosho
ofosho.description: Good ramen, a great playa moment! Serving the ramen experience on the playa the last 12 years. Doodle or dance to deep house or minimal techno while you wait, noodlessly polaroid yourself or connect with 100s of fellow burners either noodling around or slurping an irresistible bowl of happiness (we have got you covered vegetarians!). Ofosho memorable!

soulshakers.name: Soulshakers
soulshakers.description: Our camp is a playground for the free-spirited and a home base for nomads with a thirst for connection and adventure. We're a global tribe of dream-chasers and boundary-pushers, supporting each other to live our best lives; from the peaks of New Zealand to the shores of Thailand, and everywhere in between. We are solid as a community and feel that the space we hold between us can inspire other Bur

ogpit.name: The OG Pit
ogpit.description: The OG PIT is a little fire, a little fancy, a little filthy—but always family. We build hard, stay late, and never forget why we're here. arthaus.description: A collective of musicians and dancers dedicated to creating classical and contemporary productions on playa and sharing their art with the citizens of Black Rock City. We are a mix of professional and recreational artists and their supporters from all over the world.

flattirecafe.name: Flat Tire Cafe

frozenoasis.name: Frozen Oasis
frozenoasis.description: Home of the Dust City Symphony. Shelter from the storm and relax under the misters with a yummy frozen slushy drink and a live classical music performance.

impromptutomato.name: Impromptu Tomato
impromptutomato.description: Your neighborhood coffeeshop serving The Playa's Most Adequate Coffee every morning. Bring your cup, milks, sugars, light snacks, shade, and good conversation provided. yummm.name: Yummm
yummm.description: Yummm is a camp dedicated to creating Yummmy (non-food) moments for everyone on playa!

bettysbikeshop.name: Betty's Bike Shop
bettysbikeshop.description: Hometown: Federal Way – Auburn Bring your broken bike to our camp and With Consent we will help you get to a Happy Ending. Limited Hours of Happiness so Cum Early for Best Results.

weirdsteel.description: Welcome to Reared In Steel aka Weird Steel, a dynamic Burningman camp where steel artistry takes center stage. organization.description: It's hot outside! The Organization will cool you down and pump your energy up with our iced espresso martinis designed to wake you up and get you ready to party again! Daily 1-3pm.

habitatforinsanity.name: Habitat for Insanity
habitatforinsanity.description: We create novel burner technology and use it to bring new experiences to Black Rock City. This includes shave ice machines invented by camp members, HVAC/refrigeration adaptations for our new installation "The Tundra," and geodesic dome design by one of the Burning Man old school masters.

midnightroast.name: Midnight Roast
midnightroast.description: Late Night Afterhours Coffee + Music! The ONLY coffee service after midnight.

bettertogether.name: Better Together
bettertogether.description: Better Together Camp is where sparks fly and connections are made—literally, we're not responsible for any Playa-induced lightning strikes. 😎 Our Speed Dating isn't your average meet-and-greet; it's all about real conversations, radical self-expression, and a little bit of magic. Whether you're a Burning Man newbie or a dusty veteran, we've got a spot for you to connect, laugh, and maybe even find

alphabetcookout.name: The Alphabet Cookout
alphabetcookout.description: The Alphabet Cookout is a camp that is by and for BIPOC & LGBTQIA+ folx and our accomplices and allies. From potlucks to games to dance parties to singalongs, we seek to build intersectional community by individually and collectively working and playing hard together.

vagabondsandtagalongs.name: Vagabonds & Tagalongs
vagabondsandtagalongs.description: A camp for wanderers and wanderlust! Vags and Tags brings together an ever-expanding nationwide community of burners to co-create a space where everyone can feel at home. Come by and see for yourself why we've won the official BRC award for best friends on playa since 2012!

bestyearyet.name: Best Year Yet
bestyearyet.description: Providing the best hot drip coffee on playa every morning. Come enjoy a cup of Joe, a game of cribbage (or learn cribbage) and pay a visit to our magical gaseous zucchini king, Zucczilla!

ufo.name: U.f.o.
ufo.description: U.F.O. is an oasis by day to pamper yourself and relax in a cozy, shaded environment with great music. At night we turn up the bass and the fire. Lots of personality

brandingandbooze.name: Branding & Booze
brandingandbooze.description: Hometown: San Francisco Bring your own leather and leave with a piece of playa-forged art! Use our cattle irons to brand or our stamping machine to stamp Burning Man-related images (like the man or city map)! We will have pre-cut leather for those without an item to bring. Enjoy our homemade liquors, chill in our shade, listen to our music, and play our Barn Games. Look for bright blue shade!

stag.name: Stag Camp
stag.description: At Stag Camp, we invite anyone and everyone (drama-free), including singles, couples, and small groups from all walks of life. We have no strict regimen of things to do or fees to pay. Everyone contributes as much as they like, with radical self-reliance a camp cornerstone. If you're looking for shared showers, meal plans, kitchen shifts, etc., we're not the spot for you. We all just come and hang

litaf.name: Lit AF
litaf.description: Tired of stumbling around in the dark like a lost puppy? Lit AF's mission is to save the darkwads and bring light to the darkside! What we provide to the Burning Man community: - Fairy lights galore for your bike, backpack, or clothes - batteries included! - Daily events and workshops to bling out your gear and become the brightest light in the desert! - Darkwad Patrol - our team of dedicated ligh

brc3pobrc300postoffice.name: BRC3PO (BRC 3:00 Post Office)
brc3pobrc300postoffice.description: Set in a giant rural postbox, the Black Rock City 3:00 Post Office (BRC3PO) provides postal services up to 16 hours per day. We offer authentic, one-on-one, creative interactions that range from the side-splittingly silly to the supremely sublime. We also provide an array of curated Burning Man postcards and postage to send those postcards anywhere in the world - as our gift to the citizens of Bla

pinkspot.name: The Pink Spot
pinkspot.description: The Pink Spot is an art car support camp with The Big Bunny art car, Dj driven holding up to 40 burners. We will leave camp every evening around dusk, please come by for a prefunk and hop on for a thorough throw down!

here.name: Here
here.description: Here-n-Burn Drive Thru: The playa's best drive thru weddings, breakfast sandwiches, and blind speed dating experience.

noname.name: Camp [No Name]
noname.description: An international camp hosting DJs, yoga, workshops, theme parties, a bar for the thirsty, cozy lounging, bar games and flogging/kink dungeon. Specializing in dubious advice and questionable antics.

kerosene.name: Camp Kerosene
kerosene.description: Black Rock City's premiere laser engraving camp. Solar powered gifts from The Playa

key.name: The Key Camp
key.description: The Key = Believe. We have a key for you to open any doors. During our interactive events, we will find your key and guide you on how to open any doors with it. We will serve Miso Soup and cold Japanese green tea!

ihottafterdark.name: IHOTT: After Dark
ihottafterdark.description: Hometown: Seattle IHOTT (Intergalactic House of Time Travelers) is back with a twist! This year we welcome IHOTT: After Dark, an elevated, bespoke cocktail and ramen based night time version of your old favorite time travelling camp! Grab a cocktail in our glassware from our bartender, or sit down for the best meal you’ll have all week!

quarksandrecreation.name: Quarks and Recreation
quarksandrecreation.description: Games for Progress! Play! Scientists vs. Morlocks! Discover! Nuclear Fusion Bocce-Golf! Learn! The modern wonders of the Atomic Age! Your local Quarks and Recreation department invites you to experience our comprehensive catalog of nuclear-inspired games, physics trivia, labyrinthian bureaucracy, and definitely-not-radioactive "drinks" at the elusive h-bar. (Void where the strong nuclear force is

17virgins.name: 17 Virgins
17virgins.description: 17 Virgins invites you to the transdimensional portal. Come explore our 250' long tunnel to another universe! Who knows you may find a hidden doorway to the party of your dreams.

celestialteagarden.name: Celestial Tea Garden
celestialteagarden.description: Welcome to Celestial Tea Garden Camp, a vibrant, women-led, multicultural oasis celebrating the rich diversity of culture in our vibrant zen tea dome amidst the dusty canvas of Burning Man. We are multi culture camp bringing asian traditions to the playa. Our camp is a sanctuary where ancient traditions meet modern playfulness, all dedicated to fostering a deep sense of community, understanding, a

steep.name: Steep?
steep.description: GOOD JOB! You made it to Burning Man. Now come playfully question existence with us at STEEP?. Explore you inner child with games, heckling, random acts of wonder, authenticity, connection, and... DRINKS. We love them. With alcohol, without alcohol, and often featuring plant extracts and ALWAYS made with love. Come Drink in the Love at camp STEEP? ya weirdos.

fatwatt.name: Fatwatt
fatwatt.description: Experience Ego Death, an interactive electric chair.

badlands.name: badlands
badlands.description: Badlands is a live music open jam camp. Formed in 2011, we have always had a drum kit (or 3), amps, guitar, bass, keys, and a PA with microphones available for anyone that wants to come by and play. All levels of musicianship (within reason haha) are welcome!! We are open from 1-5 Mon-Fri and oftentimes have random night jams too! We have topless bartenders and bottomless drinks at our bar and a c

fluffycloud.name: The Fluffy Cloud
fluffycloud.description: Home of the The Fluffy Cloud! A giant 360-degree immersive sound and light installation towering 3 stories tall and equally wide, the Cloud is a one-of-a-kind art amplification platform hosting a variety of musical interactivity throughout the week. From world-class DJs to interactive jukebox nights, join us under the Cloud every day of the week to get your taint-shaken by 60,000 watts of overhead

iloveelephants.name: I Love Elephants
iloveelephants.description: I Love Elephants is a vibrant, interactive camp celebrating art, movement, and mindful connection. Home to the Be Here Now Pavilion (in partnership with the Ram Dass Foundation), we host transformative workshops, ecstatic dance, and dharma talks. Our camp features a 45' marquee with glowing elephant art, a mutant vehicle called The Orb, immersive projection spaces, and a 3,500 sq ft padded dance f
iloveelephants.instagram_display_name: I Love Elephants Camp | Burning Man

bloom.name: Bloom Camp
bloom.description: Join us at Bloom Camp, a two-story portal of human flourishing - a climbable art installation that transforms into a stage for live music, transformative conversations, and inspiring panels. By day, stop by to enjoy our signature mimosas and fresh smoothies. By night, we come alive with DJ sets and live performances. Come Bloom with us!

northwestmist.name: Northwest Mist
northwestmist.description: World famous misting tent that is like walking into a rain forest on playa. Where we come together to provide a cool oasis for dusty travelers. We open before event opening so that the builders of our great city and art have somewhere to cool off, regenerate and talk to other builders.

imagimorphia.name: ImagiMorphia
imagimorphia.description: Welcome to Camp Imorgimorphia, a space where creativity and transformation converge. Inspired by the concept of "morphing," we invite you to explore and express your evolving self through art, interactive experiences, and collaboration. Join us for immersive installations, transformative rituals, and workshops focused on personal growth and creative expression. Whether you're seeking self-discover

bioluminatibikemutation.name: Bioluminati (Bike Mutation)
bioluminatibikemutation.description: Unadorned cyclists beware-- The Style Enforcement Officers will be back in person in the dust to issue citations for kinetic-aesthetic violations! But fear not: the Bioluminati Bike Mutation Station - is THE destination for bicycle decoration and transformation. We gift all manner of non-moopagenic materials and accoutrements for mutating your mobile mount into something magnificent! We are open M

dustfish.name: Dustfish
dustfish.description: DUSTFISH, serving Love and Pho all week.

johnnytacomasatthelastresort.name: Johnny Tacomas at The Last Resort
johnnytacomasatthelastresort.description: Tacoma is for [GHOST] Lovers – Home of Black Rock Shoe Repair and the Inky & Clyde Mutant Vehicles. Saving Soles by Day, Chasing Souls by Night! Step in for free shoe repairs, grab a fresh pair from our BOOTique, or just haunt our shade for a spell.

dusk.name: Dusk
dusk.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno Psychedelic techno/tech-house inspired by the original sunset parties in Venice Beach, CA.

fingerbang.name: Fingerbang
fingerbang.description: Fingerbang is a rowdy crew of cheerleaders, athletes, and coaches who love to play, dance, and cheer for YOU! Come grab a megaphone and heckle from the top of our Bleachers. xoxo.name: Xoxo
xoxo.description: Welcome to your oasis on the playa! Kick back on our loungers, sip icy-cold refreshments that rotate daily, devour coconut pancakes, and get ready to make some bizarrely awesome connections. duckbutt.name: Duckbutt
duckbutt.description: Come shake your tail feathers with us for ridiculous games, crafts, cocktails, and fun performance talents.

pirate.name: Pirate Camp
pirate.description: Hometown: Jackson Pirate Camp is a diverse group of experienced burners providing Black Rock City with the finest frozen alcoholic refreshments. Are you too hot and parched to go on? Looking to make new friends? Stop by any afternoon from 1-4pm and hoist a mug with the Pirates. Margarita, Mai Tai, Daiquiri or Pina Colada.

sobremesa.name: Sobremesa
sobremesa.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Mexico City People arrive for a drink or a taco and somehow stay for hours. Inspired by the Mexican tradition of the sobremesa, this camp recreates that moment after the meal when conversation, music, and laughter keep the table alive. skyhorsecarousel.name: Skyhorse Carousel
skyhorsecarousel.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Altadena An amusement ride and a piece of art which celebrates human culture and cosmology from ancient to modern times, creating an experience with aspects of both art and play. The horses of the carousel are painted like figures from myth and legend that relate to the sky, bearing, guiding, and embodying the Sun, Moon, and stars for mortal civilization down below. You might spy one

lobe.name: Lobe
lobe.description: Hypothesis: Scientifically rigorous yet playful participation enhances your burn. Intro: LOBE invites you to experiment with our placebo bar, sci-art and brain-inspired activities. Specific Aims: Aim 1) Are you drunk!? Our speakeasy The Double-Blind Pig serves placebo-controlled refreshments. While you sip, ask the local (inebriated?) scientists all your burning questions (results may vary) Aim 2)

sluttputt.name: Slutt Putt
sluttputt.description: Mini-Golf with a Slutty Twist. Get strokes off your game for committing various 'slutty' acts posted at each of 9 holes. After your game, swing by the clubhouse for an Arnold Palmer or John Daly during our bar hours, or just relax and enjoy the music any time. Innuendo, phallic symbols, and juvenile genitalia-themed obstacles and decor abound.

barbotsbabyneedsabreak.name: Barbots: Baby Needs A Break
barbotsbabyneedsabreak.description: Hometown: Santa Barbara Feeling dusty, crooked, or cosmically misaligned? Does Baby Need a Break? The Barbots have you covered. Wander in for pop up bar hours, spa style pampering, karaoke, champagne saber lessons, and our famous Struggle Bus for anyone whose Burn has gone sideways. Recover at Tuesday Bruncho de los Muertos, branch out at Wednesday Cosmic Treehouse Happy Hour, realign your dusty a

chickendragon.name: Chicken Dragon
chickendragon.description: Hometown: Rochester, NY Our camp is home to our mutant vehicle, Chicken Dragon – Hatchery Gone Wrong. Our hatchery has tried to obtain and hatch dragon eggs, but there have been issues, resulting in creatures that look a bit more like chickens. burntown.name: Burntown
burntown.description: Don't call it a comeback, we been here for years! Burntown is back again ready to ROCK the playa. Come try the Rope Bridge of DEATH. Savor many exotic tobacco and herbal snuff varieties in our SNUFF Emporium. Shop for that special something in our General Store. Relax and enjoy our Art Gallery, which will have all sorts of artwork and guest speakers throughout the week. At Burntown, expect the une

honeypuddle.name: Honey Puddle
honeypuddle.description: Honey Puddle gives you that warm, sweet, exhilarating feeling of being enveloped by love and friendship. And music and mead and dancing and light. We're not a quiet camp, we're not a not-quiet camp. We're just right...and we'll be here when you want us. We fit like warm pajamas.

randompants.name: Camp Random Pants
randompants.description: Lovers of leggings and all things pants. Home of the Random Pizza Experience and Drone Team Convergence.

blackrockdiscgolfclub.name: Black Rock Disc Golf Club
blackrockdiscgolfclub.description: Black Rock Disc Golf Club has a mushroom-themed disc golf course which embraces fun, games, friendly competition, collaboration, and creativity. We provide a place where folks can join together and throw one of the custom stamped discs loaned out at the camp. You can win one at one of our tournaments or events! The course is accessible 24/7, and discs glow in the dark so don't hesitate to swing by

barmactropolis.name: Bar Mactropolis
barmactropolis.description: We are a full-service Bar. All are welcome. In the morning, we serve coffee, extra libation, and blood Mary's! For the rest of the day come by for a blended drink that you can blend with our custom-made blender or enjoy a cocktail or beer. Our music is chill and our bartenders the best!

icuimpromptucraftersunion.name: ICU:  Impromptu Crafters Union
icuimpromptucraftersunion.description: Suffering from crafter withdrawal? Visit the ICU for a daily dose of creativity in the shade, cuz making Art cures what ails ya! Craft offerings change daily.

deserthealers.name: Desert Healers
deserthealers.description: A welcoming sanctuary will provide a great refuge for those seeking to rest, meditate, decompress or rejuvenate. Experience Reiki Sessions with Desert Healers

amma.name: Amma
amma.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Mexico City Meaning: “Mother”, we create and hold space for everyone. This is our offering. A communal oasis. A home. A place to be curious and feel nourished. To reset and share our gifts. All are welcome. All are free. All are one. Contact

hairofthedoghotd.name: Hair of the Dog (HOTD)
hairofthedoghotd.description: HOTD(Hair Of The Dog) is the oldest longest running bar at Burning Man. We hold a piece of the original fire. HOTD gives raw performances and spontaneous acts and entertainment powered by you! HOTD is a donation bar ran on participation and gifts by burners like you! If you bring the booze and the music, then we supply the music and the booze!

tossedandsauced.name: Tossed and Sauced
tossedandsauced.description: Hometown: Chicago Tossed and Sauced — a few tossers and some fun-loving saucers are making pizza. We will have pizza on three scheduled days and a couple of pop-up parties. Bring good vibes and a napkin.

equilibrium.name: Camp Equilibrium
equilibrium.hometown: Northen California, Bay Area, Sacramento, Canada, Florida, Australia
equilibrium.description: Equilibrium has been established as a destination to represent the pinnacle for the collective first world culture in which we live: vacation. Adhering to a strict belief that our shared time together should be one of joy and relaxation, we seek to strike the all too difficult balance of hard work and play. It is here that we have constructed a series of spaces and activities to ensure that all wh

lollypopolus.name: Lollypopolus
lollypopolus.description: Lollypopoluis is a theme camp based in Portland Oregon with campers from Portland, Boise, Montreal, CA and Tokyo Japan. We are focused on Self Care and provide the Self Care Pharmacy for those items you may have forgotten or didn't know you'd need. Join us in the Circus tent for music, food, beverages and connection!

yesplease.name: Yes Please
yesplease.description: Yes: adv. – Used to express affirmation, agreement, positive affirmation, or consent. Please: adv. – Give pleasure to or to be pleasing to; give satisfaction. Yes Please is the answer to every question. Come chill in our calm and revitalizing sanctuary, dance with new friends, and experience our inclusive oasis of sex-positivity, queer empowerment, and love. Be sure to visit our infamous Non-Monog

artcar.name: Art Car Camp
artcar.description: on Playa since 1994 a Place to gather and get your issues resolved To reunite with old friends and make new ones Gandhi's Garage for mechanical issues Barter Bob's Lost Camp Supplies for Gear Madam Mo for seeing your Tomorrow Today through her many skills

twilightlanguage.name: Twilight language
twilightlanguage.description: A collective of creators on a mission to realize conceptual visual art and cultivate energy around it. Our passion is to create bold, interactive, innovative, and novel experiences.

whynauts.name: Whynauts
whynauts.description: Our mission at The Whynauts is to create a space of curiosity and discovery - encouraging everyone to say, "Why not?" Come explore with us with daily 3pm sensory workshops while being served quesadillas & piña coladas.

astraloutpost.name: Astral Outpost
astraloutpost.description: Astral Outpost is a place where the ethereal meets the earthly. We invite you to transcend the ordinary and explore the depths of the cosmos. At Astral Outpost, you may encounter a diverse array of beings - stargazers, scientists, engineers, activists, spiritual seekers and cosmic voyagers. Engage in thought-provoking dialogues during our Salon Talks or simply bask in the company of like-minded so

baretentacles.name: Camp Bare Tentacles
baretentacles.description: Hometown: Maui We offer a simple mix of bodywork, basic hospitality, and low key communal space. On Monday and Thursday afternoons we serve hot dogs/vegan dogs and easy tropical cocktails, giving neighbors a chill place to pause and refuel. After dark, we maintain a small fire pit where people can gather, warm up, and unwind. We also offer massages on Tuesday and Thursday. Come by anytime and fly

abstininthe.name: Abstininthe
abstininthe.description: The friendly bar on the playa, providing our special drink to the thirsty of BRC since the last millennium. Come try our many flavors and enjoy the music, ambiance and conversation of our neighborhood bar. Now serving non-alcoholic shrubs.

amulet.name: Amulet
amulet.hometown: All Corners of the globe, but mostly SF Bay Area
amulet.description: Whether you seek magic or inspiration, join us at Camp Amulet. At our Amulet table, you'll be gifted a brass dog tag; pre-stamped with the Burning Man symbol. Our highly skilled Amulet Counselors will guide and inspire you to make your mark, and answer the great pressing questions of your life as you customize your Amulet. Using metal stamping tools you can add names, numbers, symbols, astrologica

domeontherange.name: Dome on the Range
domeontherange.description: Yeehaw! We're your Dome away from Home! Slingin' mystery drinks and curious cures for all that ails ya. We're the weird neighborhood waterin' hole you keep comin' back to. Whether just starting your night or wandering your weary way home, come saddle up to the bar; we've got a cure for all that ails ya.

castaway.name: Camp Castaway
castaway.description: Hometown: Reno A welcoming, shaded, interactive neighborhood lounge where participants of all ages can stop in, engage, and connect. Our primary gift to Black Rock City will be freshly prepared micheladas, a traditional Mexican beer cocktail made with beer, savory Bloody-Mary-style mix, and chili-lime salt on the rim. We offer life size games, lively conversation, and will gift Nevada pendants one

butter.name: Camp Butter
butter.description: Camp Butter is not only a camp of deliquescent souls. It is a movement... a way of sliding through life with a groove at your sails. Equipped with DJ's, Butter-Inspired drinks, and a universal deep desire to churn ~ We're here to spread a simple message... "Talk less, slide more", -The Butter Crew

netsah.name: NetsaH
netsah.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Tel Aviv Explorers and curious souls, every shared energy is etched into eternity.

dustcircus.name: Dust Circus
dustcircus.description: We are a multicultural and multinational group of people with various backgrounds and lifestyles who decided to create a special space on the Playa. Come to us to have fun and participate in all our activities - Acroyoga, Shibari, New Year celebration, Art Installation. aplayamask.name: A-playa-mask
aplayamask.description: Breathe easy with the Maskman's quality N-95 Dusk Masks with the non toxic psychedelic Burning Man logo. And don't forget our Breathe Easy nose plugs, BM Stickers, and Pins.

chillvilleontheesplanade.name: ChillVille on the Esplanade
chillvilleontheesplanade.description: In the heart of Chill Ville, amidst the flickering flames and rustic charm, one finds not merely a bar, but a realm where the boundaries between patron and bartender blur into obscurity, and fire is served! powerhouse.name: Powerhouse
powerhouse.description: PowerHouse is the on-Playa home of the Sunbelt Rental Power and Heavy Equipment service teams for Burning Man DPW and dozens of Theme Camps.

bungalow.name: Bungalow
bungalow.description: La Ville Bohème is a haven for the artistically inclined, seeker of depth, eccentric soul. Calling all musicians and lovers of music to come play, dance in the Bohemian living room.

throughthelookingglass.name: Through the Looking Gl.ass
throughthelookingglass.description: Travel back time with us to ancient China few thousand years ago. You may encounter some ancient Chinese looking men and women. Be prepared! We will teach you how to use brushes and water ink to write Chinese characters in a traditional way. Of course some exotic Chinese Liquor will be served too.

gearsandbeers.name: Gears & Beers
gearsandbeers.description: From rusted out Jalopies to busted Art Cars, we're your on-playa resource for vehicle, art car and mobility equipment repairs. Repa

juicyrootz.name: Juicy Rootz
juicyrootz.description: Welcome to Juicy Rootz, where the fruit is juicy, the vibes are juicier. Swing by and meet us, the delightfully playful, slightly unhinged, and always heart-centered Juicies! celestialbodies.name: Celestial Bodies
celestialbodies.description: For 21 years, Celestial Bodies has been your friendly, all inclusive, gay bar on the playa. Brining you fun, daily events in a welcoming environment.

cozydinosaur.name: Cozy Dinosaur
cozydinosaur.description: a safe and cozy place to party, relax and meet new friends! During the day, come escape the elements in our cozy shade structure where we'll be serving ice cold flavored seltzers. playapology.description: You eff up, we fix it! terribleturtle.name: Terrible Turtle
terribleturtle.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Boulder A camp at the meeting point of artificial intelligence, creative practice, and the felt sense of being alive. What happens when a machine reads your cards, or a workshop on consciousness ru

roastedbreauxsandcoffeeheauxs.name: Roasted Breauxs & Coffee Heauxs
roastedbreauxsandcoffeeheauxs.description: Roasted Breauxs & Coffee Heauxs Coffee Roasting on the Playa & serving pour over coffee in BRC since 2011. We serve single origin coffee Mon/Wed/Fri 11-2PM We will focus on reducing our carbon footprint in BRC

kaleidoscopecollective.name: Kaleidoscope Collective
kaleidoscopecollective.description: Kaleidoscopes bring together light and color in patterns in change. Since 2014 we've been continuing to rotate in an ever more expansive, ever more beautiful way. practice.description: Practicing Burning Man in all the best ways! Come by for our daily Practices from arty to farty. Interact with the truly unique Exquisite Dorks & We Are art pieces. whiskeyanddust.hometown: Denver, Washington DC, Seattle and more
whiskeyanddust.description: We are a Whiskey Theme Camp with a habitual yoga problem, as we like to joke. Serving mid-high end whiskey at our funky little bar.

chickencootersoup.description: Chicken Cooter Soup, a band of misfits, born of the playa, dedicated to give back via hot dogs, icy treats, and carnival games

endoftheline.name: End of the Line
endoftheline.description: We welcome all Dusty Burners, and whiskey-soaked ghosts of the Old West. We offer mischief and laughter to rattle your bones—consensually, of course. Or perhaps you'd rather just belly up to the bar, trade tall tales, and plot a Burner takeover of the Default World.

sonicboomsaloon.name: SonicBoom Saloon
sonicboomsaloon.description: Come enjoy some old west drinks while you learn to crack a whip or gamble your precious shwag away.

soulsound.name: SoulSound
soulsound.description: Step into SoulSound, where rhythm meets intention and every visitor becomes part of the magic. Let the music guide you—through sound journeys, dance jams, and moments that move something deep within. Whether you're flowing with the beat or sharing meaningful exchanges, every note and connection is designed to touch your soul. Come curious, leave transformed.
soulsound.instagram_display_name: S O U L S O U N D

pinkyswears.name: Pinky Swears
pinkyswears.description: We are the art support camp for Looking Up Arts. We design and fabricate art in San Francisco, CA. Our camp is open to teaching and mentoring art fabrication skills, and we accept new members with sponsorship through late July, depending on space.

kurenivka.name: Kurenivka
kurenivka.description: Reboot, reconnect, and restore. Our camp offers a sanctuary of relaxation and cultural immersion through the Reboot Experience, a journey designed to refresh your mind, body, and spirit. Step into our Carpathian Tea Ceremony, where you'll savor herbal blends sourced from the mountains of Ukraine, prepared with care and accompanied by storytelling that weaves together history, tradition, and mindfu

cheatcodes.name: Cheat Codes
cheatcodes.description: Cheat Codes is a bespoke analog arcade offering games of wit and dexterity 24/7. Come play with us!

worstbar.name: Worst Bar
worstbar.description: Drink Shit and Die: Worst Bar gifts experiences in the form of beverages/rituals during our scheduled Unhappy Hours. The consensual experiences are not pleasurable in the expected sense and include but are not limited to mild or moderate elements of pain, humiliation, embarrassment, and disgust or combinations thereof.

oceyolotlsanctuary.name: Oceyolotl Sanctuary
oceyolotlsanctuary.description: Jaguar Temple welcomes burners for evening healing ceremonies, traditional Mexican live music, out of this world singing, legends telling and much more spiritual and fun experiences. Enjoy our special cacao, rituals and magical atmosphere!

contraptionists.name: Contraptionists
contraptionists.description: Join us, 1 to 3 PM, for our afternoon Fire and Ice parties with Snowcones and FireFries. Over heated kids can ask if we have ice anytime to cool off their little Brains. (Any age in destress will be helped.) Check the schedule for Yoga classes, or having your reading done. or just come cool off in the shade and watch the world go by.

pennysmashingpoint.name: Penny Smashing Point
pennysmashingpoint.description: Our custom pressed penny machine turns ordinary pennies into unique BM souvenirs.

baochickawowwow.name: Bao Chicka Wow Wow
baochickawowwow.description: Come hungry, not hangry. Visit Bao Chicka Wow Wow to taste our bao (dim sum buns)! Fill your belly with our fresh and delicious steamed-to-order pork, red-bean, and custard bao. Hours: Sunday Sunset: 5pm - 8pm (SUN) Brunch: 11am - 2pm (MON, TUES, WED)

rhythmwave.name: RhythmWave
rhythmwave.description: RhythmWave brings Conscious Dance to the Playa, along with yoga and other movement practices. 5Rhythms, Open Floor, Soul Motion and others. We offer a space to figure out what is going on inside you and to move through it. Not just a place to show off your latest dance moves. Our offerings are made on a sprung bamboo wood floor beneath a shade structure, and are offered several times daily.

heartfusion.name: Heart Fusion
heartfusion.description: Heart Fusion invites you to step through its pulsating hearts into an LED-lit Heart Glow Labyrinth of reflection, mindfulness, and wonder. Join us to share a relaxing beverage, and take a break in the heart chill cubes. Then continue into an immersive experience of throbbing lights which everyone will add a light to within the cuddle puddle dome. The space invites you to lay down, take in the ligh

blackrockyearbook.name: Black Rock Yearbook
blackrockyearbook.description: Every year at Burning Man, since 2007, we set up a professional shooting gallery and photographers to give out playa names and take your Black Rock Yearbook Photo! Hosting the archive for tens of thousands of Burners online at blackrockyearbook.com

astralsocialclub.name: The Astral Social Club
astralsocialclub.description: A home on the playa for experimental, ambient, acoustic, classical and celestial music. Indulge in our house made elixirs and tinctures at our non-alcoholic bar; let your consciousness slip through our transdimensional portal. Elevate and expand.

soontobeinfamous.name: Soon to be Infamous
soontobeinfamous.description: Your burn is Soon to Be Infamous! Stop by and decorate a flag with your playa name and address during our Don't Fucking Leave Your Fucking Bike on the Fucking Playa! Bicycle Flag Creation Station Events and help us end bikicide, the careless abandonment of an innocent bike to wither and die on the playa.

discosmos.name: Discosmos
discosmos.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Mexico City tired of having fun in the sun? take a momento for downtempo. come chill with us at Malio’s, the bar with the best view on the playa

teamhumanbase.name: Team Human Base Camp
teamhumanbase.description: A far-flung conglomerate of artist, loonies and weirdos from California, Oregon, Texas and Indiana coming together support to provide an interactive and unique space for live music, DJs, performance artist and speakers to share their offers. Come be a character in our quirky little variety show.

bestbutt.name: Best Butt
bestbutt.description: Camp Best Butt is dedicated to the relentless appreciation and promotion of all things buttocks related. How do you achieve the Best Butt? It's 90% confidence and 10% squats.

lituanicabirds.name: Lituanica Birds
lituanicabirds.description: We are Lituanica Birds Camp, a community that travels across the ocean to Black Rock City, bringing with us a cascade of ideas, energy, and love. Inspired by the freedom and grace of birds, our camp is a home to the endless journey of exploration. At our core, we believe in the beauty of connection with nature, others, and with oneself. Our camp offers welcoming spaces where every visitor is invit

lovana.name: Lovana
lovana.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Fremont Step into a lively corner of Chinese street-food hospitality on playa. Expect rare regional comfort food, shared seating, drinks, and a warm place to pause, gather, and connect with strangers. Draw a Blessing Card, leave a Love Note, and stay a little longer than you planned. Come for the aroma and curiosity, stay for the conversation and human connection.

nyccommunitycontainer.name: NYC Community Container
nyccommunitycontainer.description: We Guarantee Nothing! But you'll probably pick up your gear from us if you're from NYC/NJ

sundowners.name: Sundowners
sundowners.description: 'Sundowners' comes from a South African friendship ritual we host Monday to Friday at sunset. A safari-themed art car and joyous South African "shebeen" speakeasy are our experiential tentpoles. Our creative center is Afrofuturism, imagining a positive, inclusive future through speculative art and technology, representing the diverse background and skills of our community. We feel Burning Man, as

carrotclub.name: The Carrot Club
carrotclub.description: Our camp is focused on health and happiness; health through fresh vegetables and fruits at the Black Rock Farmers Market in the mornings and happiness and festivities at the Carrot Club in the afternoons. Enjoy tasty, fresh produce to feed the body, refresh the spirit, and nourish the soul! One of the best parts of exploring any city is checking out the farmer's market- and Black Rock City is no e

dogsnrecreation.name: Dogs N Recreation
dogsnrecreation.description: Neighborhood Mini-Rec Center offering badminton/outdoor games, vegan and hot dogs, live postcards and board games. Chill, on the outer roads, filled with a little chaos. Grab a dog! Grab a chair! Let's play!

fur.name: Fur
fur.description: FUR is a theme camp of furries, who come together to collaborate in the shared theme of Anthropomorphic Art, Costuming, and Culture.

coolsville.name: Coolsville
coolsville.description: Hometown: Coolsville, USA An art support camp made up of builders, fabricators, and artists who come to Black Rock City to help bring projects to life. Many camp members are involved in Honoraria or placed art installations, and the camp functions as a home base for people spending most of their time working on art across the city. Our street frontage includes a few small interactive elements incl

backfire.name: Backfire
backfire.description: A small camp composed of ASL signers that loves to bring a little bit of their community and experience to the citizens of Black Rock City! We have Vietnamese Coffee and ASL every morning, along with our popular Lil Fixit Shop if you have something that needs fixing. Or come by in the afternoon to check out our ASL confessional booth!

interzone.name: Interzone
interzone.description: Transport yourself to another time and place as you enter Tangier's International Zone. Grab a book from our Lost Times Library and hang out in our lounge area, open 24/7. Library Loud Hours daily from 3pm-6pm with iced Moroccan mint tea and craft beer on tap!

morningwood.name: Camp Morning Wood
morningwood.description: Welcome to Camp Morning Wood! Which is, quite simply, your friendly, neighborhood, summer camp-themed, saloon. Starting fresh each morning at 10:00 a.m. to "Eye of the Tiger" we're there to motivate the neighborhood, to attack a new day (after licking our wounds from the night before). CMW is ready to greet you with a smile, music, dancing, or maybe just a view of the city from our raised platform

justdandy.name: Just Dandy
justdandy.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno Support camp for Dandy mutant vehicle.

ednasoasis.name: Edna's Oasis
ednasoasis.description: Edna's Oasis, where the elephants instinctively flock like the bassheads of capastrano. Feel the rumble of every step.

andthentheresonlylove.name: And Then There's Only Love
andthentheresonlylove.description: Home of the world famous Orgy Dome – where couples & moresomes of all orientations are invited to come and play. We welcome the combination of love in all forms. We're a sex-positive, inclusionary, and exploratory space that's been a place of fire, fun, and passion since 2003. Everyone wishing to enter the Orgy Dome receives a detailed orientation covering Informed Enthusiastic Consent. Remember,

twisted.name: Twisted
twisted.description: Twisted Camp is a vibrant gathering space where creativity, connection, and community come to life. Our camp features a welcoming bar with mixologists (you never know what drink concoction we might have!), a cozy coffee station, and a lively atmosphere with music by DJ Tokenoshi. Expect a mix of interactive experiences, social spaces, and spontaneous fun. Our setup includes a well-lit bar, plush s

shifttheatmosphere.name: Shift the atmosphere
shifttheatmosphere.description: Hometown: Atlanta Committed to spreading love and healing to the citizens of Black Rock City through guided meditation, genuine connection, emotional support and real community. Please stop by for our spiritual painting workshops, interactive music offerings, emotional release ceremonies or just to stop by and join us for coffee and matcha. Contact

nocinos.name: Nocino's
nocinos.description: That cozy social place where people come to hang after a long day of [redacted] and [censored] to connect with beer, pizza, and good music.

wordplaycafe.name: Word Play Cafe
wordplaycafe.description: Word Play Cafe is the space at Burning Man dedicated entirely to word games for people to gather, play and learn together. Visitors to Word Play Cafe can play favorite daily games, classic word games, and custom games like our Burning Man themed crossword, and other new word games we created just for Burning Man in our 30 ft dome. We also serve cold brew coffee daily from a cute vintage trailer ju

industwetrust.name: In Dust We Trust
industwetrust.description: A lovely camp, which has been giving away lingerie and pasties in exchange for a good life story for over 10 years now, serving snow cones in the afternoon sun and filled with people from all over the world, whose paths to our camp are always somehow unique and worth a story.

spankyswinebar.name: Spanky's Wine Bar
spankyswinebar.description: The infamous crown-jewel of Burning Man bars. We take a tongue-in-cheek approach to wine, and a paddle-to-cheek approach to your butt ;)

steambathproject.name: Steam Bath Project
steambathproject.description: The original and still the best steam bath experience. Step into a world of relaxation and rejuvenation at The Steam Bath Project. Located at the heart of Burning Man, our camp offers a unique and immersive experience inspired by the soothing power of steam. Enter our tranquil oasis and indulge in the therapeutic benefits of steam bathing, surrounded by the sights, sounds, and scents of the desert

mellowmountain.name: Mellow Mountain
mellowmountain.description: Mellow Mountain invites you to trade smooches with the Kissy Fish art car, play on our swings and rings, and be served espresso martinis.

gyst.name: Gyst
gyst.description: Hometown: Sacramento WE are your burniest, neighborhood compost collector. Accepting your DRY, contaminant-free, compost daily from 3pm to 6pm. Check out our BAR and LOUNGE for drinks and trash talk! DJs and theme parties all week! Axis your Mundi at our DINKO game! Dinko Plinko is an exciting game of chance where players drop a disc or ball down a pegged board, with the outcome determined by rand

mightymisfits.name: Mighty Misfits
mightymisfits.description: A Mighty Misfit is a person whose behavior or attitude sets them apart from others in a conspicuous way, yet somehow makes it okay. A fish out of water, square peg in a round hole, round peg in a square hole. If you've ever felt you don't fit in in the default world, come and play with the Mighty Misfits. We are a welcoming, dusty respite with a misfit list of activities. Feed your body and soul w

hangoutthe.name: Hang-Out, the
hangoutthe.description: Welcome to our hammock oasis, where ethereal visions of community unfold beneath the swaying sails of wonder and delight. Here, vibrant hammocks create a mosaic of color, gently cradling souls seeking solace and connection. Sunlight filters through, casting playful shadows while laughter dances on the breeze. Friends share stories and dreams, weaving together their hopes in a tapestry of shared mo

societyofsupremeexcellence.name: The Society of Supreme Excellence
societyofsupremeexcellence.description: The Society for the Pursuit of Supreme Excellence cordially invites you to get improved physical & mental wellbeing through our elite Flexcore workouts, Yoga sessions & acoustic & amplified jams.

saltyjacks.name: Salty Jacks
saltyjacks.description: Your local deep dive bar and your safe-port in the storm, open daily. A nautical disco grotto with salty libations and an eclectic fleet of DJs.

burningsky.name: Burning Sky
burningsky.description: Skydivers over Burning Man. Come see Black Rock City from 9,000 feet in the air. Watch the skydivers exit the plane while you stay safely inside, and get an exciting ride back to the earth. Gifting rides Wednesday & Thursday 11a-5p.

burningmycrpe.name: Burning My Crêpe
burningmycrpe.description: Lighting up the Playa since 2018 with the best flamed crêpes you'll ever eat. Made from scratch by people from Brittany (crêpe's original birthplace), you'll be mesmerized by our pole dancers while enjoying our crêpes in our cozy living room!

hotstuff.name: Hot Stuff
hotstuff.description: Drinks served from dawn onward for the thirsty traveler crossing the desert sands. All manner of chilli hot and ice cool refreshments will be on offer accompanied by music from storied DJs from across the savage sands.

tot.name: Tot
tot.description: Hometown: Phoenix Where people are nice, the swing set is big and where you are welcome. Contact

playaground.name: PlayAground
playaground.description: We are playground with radical swings, shade, lounge, bar, games & art.

gnometopia.name: Gnometopia
gnometopia.description: Stop by any afternoon to partake in some Gnometivities: Sing some Gnome songs Hear a Gnome talk Get a Gnome massage while listening to Gnome harp Trade Gnome outfits Complete a Gnome Quest Join us for Gnome Night on Thursday night as we explore the playa together as a flock of Gnomes. There's Gnome telling what will happen at Gnometopia!

shittyglitter.name: Shitty Glitter
shittyglitter.description: Welcome to SHITTY GLITTER, a boutique Bed and Breakfast providing the most luxurious hospitality experience in Black Rock City. Stop by for a rest in the clean white linens on one of our freshly made canopy beds (changed daily) and be sure to chat with a camp concierge to get the most out of your stay. Be sure to swing by The Parlor on Wednesday evening for our breakfast (for dinner) party where w

chicourbanarea.name: Chico Urban Area
chicourbanarea.description: Climb aboard the Intergalactic Transporter for a trip across the Playa you will never forget! We are happy to give you a cold beverage, space to dance, chill or just meet new people.

nowandthenartistcollective.name: Now and Then Artist Collective
nowandthenartistcollective.description: The Now and Then Artist Collective supports various art projects on playa and in the camp.

spacebar.name: Space Bar
spacebar.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Miami A group of humans committed to supporting art at Black Rock City. Come meet us at our art sculpture or in our open-to-all shade structure at camp.

pottyproject.name: Potty Project
pottyproject.description: Home of the Potty Project a group of volunteers helping teach LNT at the potties and make the potties fun! We offer volunteer shifts M-F of the event so stop in to sign-up!

snarkbar.name: Snark Bar
snarkbar.description: A Snarky experience awaits day or night, take a spin on the prize wheel if you dare! Our Dick n Ball pit awaits those that would prefer a cozy lightshow with a touch of nostalgia. Snark, shade, couches, a dome with hammocks and excellent drinks await dusty hot travelers of the day. WIFI Available - intermittently!

mostlyintune.name: Mostly in Tune
mostlyintune.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Santa Cruz, CA Leave with dusty shoes and a song stuck in your head. Mostly in Tune is a participatory jam camp. Join the band, borrow an instrument, sing along, enjoy live band karaoke, perform spoken word over live backing tracks, or simply enjoy the music. No experience required. campoline.name: Campoline
campoline.description: We are an artsy international dive bar of friendly folks and stiff drinks under the circus bigtop of cascading parachutes. You can jump on trampolines under the stars or sun, paint, stroll through art work, belly up to the bar, listen to canned music from show tunes to punk, watch live original music and varied performances, or climb the intellectual ladder of conversation. bui.name: Camp BUI
bui.description: The friendliest camp on the playa famous for our front porch. Drop by for a visit and a cold drink. Join us at sundown for a Shot of the Day or Thursday from 2:00 to 4:00pm for our Pineapple Upside Down Cake Thursday event. We are well known for our fine cuisine and repartee.

mooncheese.name: Moon Cheese
mooncheese.description: We're with Wallace & Gromit & still believe the moon is made out of cheese. In their honor, we serve up 10,000 grilled cheese sandwiches throughout the week to the hungry citizens of Black Rock City. Stocked with all different types of bread & cheese, including gluten-free bread & vegan cheese, as well as a range of sweet, spicy, tangy & juicy dipping sauces, we're grilling throughout the night to

aboveandbelow.name: Above & Below
aboveandbelow.description: Hometown: Richmond, CA Art Support Camp for Above and Below Honorarium Art Installation.

drplayasentclinic.name: Dr. Playa's ENT Clinic
drplayasentclinic.description: Dr Playa's ENT Clinic helps Black Rock Citizens clean out their head holes daily. Open 12PM-3PM.

greatvibrations.name: Great Vibrations
greatvibrations.description: We're not Good Vibrations—we're Great Vibrations. Our camp is a sanctuary of movement, relaxation, and high-frequency energy, dedicated to restoring and elevating Burners through the power of vibration. By day, we offer 24/7 high-end massage chairs, morning sound baths, and spontaneous spa experiences featuring cooling face masks, mint water, and head massages. As the sun sets, we transform into t

glowskullasylumintl.name: Glowskull Asylum Int'l
glowskullasylumintl.description: Glowskull Asylum Int'l brings extreme metal radical inclusion to the playa. Are you craving some good headbanging and want to meet exotic misfits from random places all over the world? Our bar, Skøllushery, and art car "Castle Glowskull" will be hosting mischief, ultra-violence, and twisted METAL (and other deranged forms of terrible music) daily. All varieties of humans welcome!

base.name: Base Camp
base.description: Home and landing pad for the Metro Chop mutant vehicle. A working camp where stuff gets done so the Black Rock City can have some fun.

po9.name: PO9
po9.description: We connect you with the world, we are the original way to get USPS mail to the playa, as we have been for decades. We do: USPS to the Playa, Playa to any (international) address with a unique artistic postmark! (US postage encouraged/required), and friendly (and not-so-friendly) posties: stand in line, and fill out your form... in triplicate... with crayon.

macgyversunion.name: MacGyvers' Union
macgyversunion.description: Every camp has a MacGyver -- now the MacGyvers have a union. We provide all MacGyvers with recognition, thanks, tools, training, entertainment, emotional and moral support, chill space away from their home camp, and an official ID card.

halfbaked.name: Half Baked
halfbaked.description: Make your official 2025 Solar Shrink-Art necklaces, earrings, keychains, bike tags & hat swag using our solar ovens. All art supplies and ovens will be provided. You COLOR it. You watch it SHRINK. You WEAR it! Walk away with some cool, commemorative, self-made swag, along with a greater understanding of the wonderful world of solar cooking. Also, try our Tabletop Tug Challenge. You’ve always wante

soulforge.name: Soul Forge
soulforge.description: Take a deep dive into personal growth and learning - Hammer out your spirit at Soul Forge!

criticalconnections.name: Critical Connections
criticalconnections.description: Connections make us a collective being. They are all critical to us. And Puppets.

plannedplayahood.name: Planned Playahood
plannedplayahood.description: We offer "second aid" services including contraceptives, pregnancy tests, and hygiene products and a Menstruation Station to help you stock up on your needs. Pay homage to Our Lady of the Shaven Beaver, where you can experience your playa rebirth. hippocampus.name: Hippocampus
hippocampus.description: Hippocampus invites you to play with us at our Pucker Up lemonade stand and hammock hang-out cafe to connect and take a break from the playa. Also find us in deep playa for refreshingly magical lemonade and sunrise pancakes and coffee.

redhanded.name: Redhanded
redhanded.description: Caught red-handed by your bodily functions? We've got your back! Stop by our elegant Victorian period lounge for period-themed drinks, and precious period supplies while enjoying fun live events. Got dust in curious places? We'll help you freshen up sustainably. Need extra care? Our cozy Red(handed) Tent offers specialized support when you're bleeding or just having a tough day. Oh, and we've got

we3campink.name: We < 3 CamPINK!
we3campink.description: Hometown: Austin, TX Join in our Family Reunion! We have large yard games for day and night play, Dj sets and our signature CamPINK! Karaoke after dark. Drop by our fabulously monochrome camp and tell us how PINK it is while you play tic-tac-toe, connect4, LED bocce, cornhole or glow Jenga. Or have a fancy cocktail while lounging in a shaded hammock enjoying our hospitality and PINKness. Everyone’

giraffelot.name: Giraffelot
giraffelot.description: From the academy-award winning studio and imagineers renowned for bringing participants TEN YEARS of well-known adventures like GIRAFFIC PARK, GIRAFFIC WORLD, AER JIRAFFA, ROYAL GIRAFFIC CRUISELINES and the astounding trilogy of UNION GIRAFFIC RAILWAYS PART(s) I & II comes an all-new cinematic masterpiece: GIRAFFELOT. This dusty time-bending magical adventure promises to be the best renaissance-fa

playapinupsandfineartfatales.name: Playa Pinups and Fine Art Fatales
playapinupsandfineartfatales.description: We are a camp consisting of playa photographers and models dedicated to capturing the beauty and diversity of the citizens of Black Rock City, while offering an opportunity to enhance personal expression through the creation of several types of art.

discrace.name: Discrace
discrace.description: Do you know how much beer can fit inside a frisbee? Join us to find out, play ultimate frisbee, and other fun competitions with fellow burners! Ultimate Frisbee is an inclusive, spirited community based around a self-officiated "sport", with events primarily organized by players themselves and gifting each other silly things. Sure feels a lot like Burning Man to us. We're here to share ultimate fr

armageddonbike.name: Armageddon Bike Camp
armageddonbike.description: It's not the end of the world, it's the safe word! Think Armageddon for all your bike needs. We've been providing Bike Love Bike Repair on-playa for about 15 years, and we offer professional bike repair daily. Or fix your own bike at our Public Bike Repair stations, 24x7! We also host great parties, don't miss our Wednesday afternoon Alley Cat Race and After Party with Funny Bike Demo! Our well-st

champagnelounge.name: Champagne Lounge
champagnelounge.description: Welcome to the Champagne Lounge! Amidst Black Rock City's hustle, our oasis offers luxurious relaxation. Step into our elegantly adorned shade, sip champagne poured by less than knowledgeable bartenders, and recline on plush playa-tech or mingle with fellow Burners. As the sun sets, enjoy twinkling lights and ambient music for a magical atmosphere. Cheers to the extraordinary!

battlebornburners.name: Battle Born Burners
battlebornburners.description: Vintage Nevada Themed Bar and Casino - Come Play, Drink and lounge with us. The Bar with Nevadatude! BRC's only Casino! High-end Cocktails, Entertainment, Gambling and other sillyness! The Loosest Sluts on the playa. BRC's most liberal blackjack table!

tourdechance.name: Tour de Chance
tourdechance.description: Êtes-vous chanceux? Ride the the Playa's largest French-themed bicycle-powered carnival game for marvelous prizes! But vélo beware, some are risqué.

deepeat.name: Deep Eat
deepeat.description: Get ready to Deep Eat with delicious food & pizza and feast your eyes on the Cosmic Bean, while enjoying loungey in-house music.

cloudyaf.name: Cloudy AF
cloudyaf.description: Feel the thunder as we BUFF and FLOG your muscles at Body Werkz, get foggy in the Steamy AF sauna, get wisped away in our evolving sprinkles of frosty bevies, drift away in a dream in our cloud pit! We are dedicated to raising the hearts, body and souls of the broader Burning Man community through our art, events, and welcoming space. We dew take our fun quite cirrus-ly. It's never been this cool

papercranes.name: Paper Cranes
papercranes.description: At our camp, we strive to create a home on the playa—a place where our campers feel just as excited to return after a long day as they are to dive into our interactive events. We keep it simple but meaningful: serving up PB&Js, letting our DJs set the vibe, and coming together each night for a family meal you won't want to miss. At the heart of our tradition, we invite visiting burners to write th

abominablebase.name: Abominable Base Camp
abominablebase.description: Hometown: Tucson Home of the Yeti Mob. We host a welcoming base camp for BRC citizens–providing cool daytime vibes and an immersive lit nighttime environment. ABC will have live DJs, parties, workshops, a book nook, and a bar for custom infused vodka tasting. Come get abominable with us.

shangrilounge.name: Shangri-Lounge
shangrilounge.description: Pop-up support camp for the Shangri-Lounge human-powered mobile martini bar in Deep Playa, the Air Band interactive performances in Central Plaza, and the Ice Taxi shuttle running from Arctica to your camp. We'll serve you the finest cocktail while you relax in intimate conversation with new friends under the stars, help you live out your life-long fantasy of being a rock star, and keep your preci

atouchysubject.name: A Touchy Subject
atouchysubject.description: A Touchy Subject is a shady spot to relax, confess, break the ice, forget about a postcard, meet a friend, or get away. Brought to you by those shady folks who didn't serve waffles.

molotovcocktail.name: Molotov Cocktail
molotovcocktail.description: Our shaded bar/chill space offers welcome respite and comfort for the dusty and thirsty. We will be bringing a variety of alcoholic beverages for the citizens of Black Rock City. We will be keeping various items on ice to refresh the weary wanderer. We offer a variety of games including cribbage, liar's dice & board games for individual and tournament play.

happyhour.name: Happy Hour
happyhour.description: Hard day on the playa? Unwind at Happy Hour, where you'll be greeted by one of a kind refreshing spirits served with smiles! Enjoy our lounge, bar, and dance floor! Start your day with Happy Hour!

chatterbox.name: Chatterbox Camp
chatterbox.description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant cacophony of creativity with the Chatterbox Art Car. This rolling masterpiece serves as a mobile platform for spontaneous conversations, fueled by the energy of the playa. Adorned with mesmerizing humans and pulsating with music, the Chatterbox invites participants to engage in dynamic dialogues, forging connections that transcend boundaries. Join the journey aboard
