burnstreamcourt.name: Burnstream Court
burnstreamcourt.description: Burnstream Court is a group of Airstream owners who recreate a 1960s trailer park, Black Rock City style. We almost always have fun daytime events happening that you can join in with. And we give away grilled cheese sandwiches midday M-F.

2girls1.name: 2 girls 1 camp
2girls1.description: We’re slinging No.1 (Yellow) and No.2 (Brown) slushies from the Center Camp Bar—fiber-spiked for flow and/or booze-spiked for fun. While you’re there, earn your “I Pooped Today” badge and snag a map for the Great Booty Hunt, our quest to find the playa’s most fabulously decorated porta-potties. Join us in the Center Camp Oculus for traditional coconut oil wrestling—thumbs welcome, dignity optional

newbarbarians.name: The New Barbarians
newbarbarians.description: The New Barbarians are a community of friends that have been burning since 2012. Together we've grown into a barbaric empire of misfits mostly based on the west coast. We look forward to another amazing year where we will yet again get to contribute and we invite the community to our events, which offer yummy food, shade, cold beer, sweet tunes, engaging talks, fun activities, and warm welcomes.

ignitedstates.name: Ignited States
ignitedstates.description: Ignited States is all about our states of mind, our states of being, our states of consciousness. It's about lighting up our worlds. It's about igniting and fanning the flames of our creativity. And sometimes, it's about igniting the fire in our bellies with a shot of fireball. - Ignite your artful state by making a flag or tetrahedron to illustrate the state you're in or immersing yourself in the

deepc.name: Deep C
deepc.description: Deep C presents: HypnoDrome — a dazzling 26-foot dome lit by over 25,000 LEDs! Step into the light and get lost in an immersive sea of color, rhythm, and movement. By day, it's a shaded oasis to relax, chill, and connect. By night, it transforms into a vibrant beacon of sound and light—perfect for dancing, lounging, or just being hypnotized by the show. Come drift in the Deep.

orgybus.name: Orgy Bus Camp
orgybus.description: Orgy Bus Camp provides a safe and clean space for poly play parties on the playa. All of our parties have an opening ceremony where we practice consent and boundaries, as well as a fun and interactive opportunity to meet other guests. Our parties are at 3 PM and 11 PM daily.

blackrockcitymunicipalpool.name: Black Rock City Municipal Pool
blackrockcitymunicipalpool.description: Looking for a place to cool down and relax? The Black Rock City Municipal Pool might be the place for you! There's something for everyone: come by for a refreshment and shady misting during one of our Open Swim sessions, bike through at night for a bit of poolside lounging in peace, or put your dancing boots to good use at our Spring Break party! Access to our Spa is supposed to only be available

palinkalounge.name: Palinka Lounge
palinkalounge.description: Palinka Lounge offers a welcoming respite for Burners new and old around the globe, we offer a comfortable environment for Burners to take a moment to relax, have a drink, introduce themselves, and learn about what it means to be a burner (or learn about Hungarian burners) gaining from our camp-members Burning Man knowledge. We do this not only through sharing a drink, but also by engaging in acti

neversleepagain.name: Never Sleep Again
neversleepagain.description: Electronic music and games, inspired by Berlin clubs and park parties. Our intimately designed dance floor surrounded by individually themed chill-spaces with beds, couches, and pillows invites you to lounge with us, dance, have a cold drink, play a game, or do all of the above at the same time. We are an international bunch of dreamers and doers and want to meet you!

sophistapiratecove.name: SophistaPirate Cove
sophistapiratecove.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Salt Lake City Word travels about a Pirate port on Esplanade, a place the SophistaPirates built when they decided to make something worth staying for. During the day, it’s a place to settle in: shaded lounges, games at Kracken’s Trap, a stop at Captain Cooks, and stories shared at the Thirsty Pearl. But it doesn’t stay quiet for long. By night, the ship wakes up. Music, fire sails, an

stardustlounge.name: Stardust Lounge
stardustlounge.description: Enter an interdimensional portal that leads to a magical experience comprised of love, silliness, and sparkly things! Stardust Lounge is an eclectic pit stop for dusty travelers on their inter-playatary journeys. The three sections of the camp--the Lounge, Spa, and Wedding Chapel--offer visitors a fun blend of rituals, games, and opportunities for self-care.

halloween.name: Halloween Camp
halloween.description: Halloween Camp brings out the inner child in all of us BOO-urners, taking us back to the haunts of that special day, where anybody can be anyone. Come knock on our door for some tricks, treats, sips & beats…if you dare!

cinderbox.name: Cinderbox
cinderbox.description: Hometown: Berkeley An art support camp for the Resilience Art Collective. We are part of a HUB with our two dear sister camps, Fingerbang! and Chico Urban Area – come find us for a visit! We are proud recipients of a 2026 BRC Honoraria Grant for our placed art project, Resilience, a larger-than-life flaming tardigrade which will be waiting somewhere on the playa to welcome you!

societyfortemporalpreservation.name: Society for Temporal Preservation
societyfortemporalpreservation.description: The Society for Temporal Preservation consists of time travelers tasked with preserving the fabric of spacetime. Space time is like a cat though, it takes care of itself. This is good, because now we can leave a bowl of food out and ignore it while we visit Black Rock City. We serve as ambassadors of the temporally free, working to introduce Black Rock City to the magic (science) of time travel. O

snugglefunk.name: Camp SnuggleFunk
snugglefunk.description: Hometown: Reno Step into a world of pure playa funk, where every moment is infused with vibrant energy and creative flair. This camp offers inviting relaxation zones to unwind and recharge, alongside dynamic dance spaces where funky beats keep spirits soaring. Engage in playful activities ranging from spontaneous art jams to quirky games, all designed to spark imagination and joyful connections. H

frenchmanila.name: French Manila
frenchmanila.description: Our camp is inspired by the melting pot of different cultures and backgrounds of our camp members who are from America, Canada, France, and the Philippines. Our founding crew met in Manila and San Francisco many years ago and we bonded over art, good food, and exploring these cities together. As our family grows over the years, one thing stays true, on playa we love hosting late afternoon themed d

goodquestion.name: Good Question
goodquestion.description: What can you expect from our camp? Good Question! Stop by our shady oasis to deepen your connection with your friends and loved ones, or meet a new friend entirely in a cozy, intimate atmosphere. You'll leave feeling more connected to others, and having formed a deeper connection with yourself. Come by in the afternoon when we will be serving tea, Dosas (Indian breakfast like a crepe) and batch te

coffeeandpasties.name: Coffee and Pasties
coffeeandpasties.description: Coffee and Pasties, bringing organic peculator coffee back the Playa with great things to add like Whiskey or Irish cream and of course all the colorful pasties!

snowkoansolar.name: SnowKoanSolar
snowkoansolar.description: Snow Koan Solar serves snow cones daily, hot dogs very late at night now and then, and provides solar-based power for a number of camps in our HUB. We also have a public charging station where smaller items can be charged.

secondrodeo.name: Second Rodeo
secondrodeo.description: Howdy, y'all! Second Rodeo welcomes any and all participants to enjoy cheeky and fun rodeo-themed activities, offerings, and wild hoedowns! If it ain't a party you seek, we also specialize in providing self care amenities to those seeking respite. Let us prove to you that this isn't our first rodeo! Come as you are, every one of y'all! Yeeeeehaw!

tidy.name: Camp Tidy
tidy.description: Welcome to Camp Tidy! Enjoy a proper cuppa at tea time and peruse our extensive collection of literature in the Tea and Porn lounge. Relax in the Playa Cloud. Recharge yourself and your devices with our solar powered charging station.

almaborekas.name: Alma Borekas
almaborekas.description: Moroccan atmosphere with Middle Eastern influence. Traditional chilling area and An open bar serving signature cocktails 2 PM - 4 PM. Our legendary Borekas will be served on Tuesday, and mint tea will warm you up at night.

flyingpegasus.name: Flying Pegasus
flyingpegasus.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Austin, Texas Fulfilling Fanciful Flying Ferry Function (for a Fucked-up Flat-Foot) Wire-art Pegasus ‘flying’ mutant vehicle presenting in MOBL form providing fanciful transportation and refreshments

chainreaction.name: Chain Reaction
chainreaction.description: Roll on by our camp for friendly bike repairs! Whether it's a flat, a squeaky chain, or some Playa mystery, we've got your bike covered so you can keep cruising without a hitch. We're here to get your ride back in action so you can keep the fun going. But it's not just about repairs—we've created a super chill space to relax, swap stories, and soak up the good vibes. Whether you need a quick fix,

island.name: The Island
island.description: A French Polynesia theme camp of mostly residents in this beautiful paradise. Wanting to share his marvelous culture with you. Don't miss out on the chance to participate in some social experiments.

hotnoodz.name: Hot Noodz
hotnoodz.description: Come on by and eat some hot noods, 24/7 noodle bar. Passport stamping and leather branding as well.

solarplus.name: SolarPlus
solarplus.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York A free solar-powered community charging lounge offering e-bike, scooter, and device charging to all citizens of Black Rock City. Powered entirely by renewable energy, our shaded lounge is open daily with hosted shifts, welcoming anyone who rolls up with a dead battery. No fees, no VIP access just a genuine gift to keep Black Rock City moving.

healingfootwashlifetruthlove.name: Healing Foot Wash Life Truth Love
healingfootwashlifetruthlove.description: Life, Truth, Love: Come sit under our cooling shade canopy and get your feet washed, dried and moisturized in a tranquil and calming environment. After you have received this gift, you are invited to participate as well. We are actively building world peace and community.

lustychanterellekombuchabar.name: Lusty Chanterelle Kombucha Bar
lustychanterellekombuchabar.description: Whisky is out- Kombucha is in. The Lusty Chanterelle Kombucha bar is a place to rest, unwind, and drop in with good conversation and a cold non-alcoholic beverage with your fellow burners. Come with an empty cup and we will fill you up and help you feel at home with the most quaffable drink on playa.

illumination.name: Illumination Village
illumination.description: Illumination Village is an eclectic gathering of camps, held together by history and shared resources. You will find within the village, much like the microcosm of Burning Man, art and interactivity everywhere. Showcasing our fire artists in the front, and then placing our interactivity within the village in our Town Square and internal roads. Each year it's a new experiment in radical collaborati

phonicbloom.name: Phonic Bloom
phonicbloom.description: Join us to experience a sound-reactive light show. Sing, play instruments, or just relax and enjoy a synesthesia-inspired experience in a relaxing and intimate environment.

burnerbuddies.name: Burner Buddies
burnerbuddies.description: We are a relaxed LGBTQI+ camp known for issuing Gay Cards, throwing the Gay Conversion Party to 'turn' people gay, and Genital Printmaking based on a traditional Japanese technique.

monkeyking.name: Monkey King Camp
monkeyking.description: Join us as we bring the legendary spirit of the Monkey King to life on the Playa! Our camp is offering immersive culture through drinks, games, music, and interactive art. Our Monkey King Art Car is decorated as the Flower Fruit Mountain like the original story. 🐵 Totems of Power: Touch-activated totems glow with Sun Wukong's mythical energy—sharing light and spirit with the Playa. 💧 Flower Fruit

synthesis.name: Camp Synthesis
synthesis.description: Camp Synthesis embodies the melding of three things: Synthesizers, Sake, and Sushi. Here's the concept: People who like producing music with synths, midi instruments, drum machines, etc., hanging out, jamming, teaching others to make music, performing live sets, share Japanese food, and sharing a drink (日本酒). Daytime event include interactive synthesizer jams in our domesynths, drum machines, samp

blackrockcityshipyard.name: Black Rock City Shipyard
blackrockcityshipyard.description: Come and experience Billy Madison's Tent! Fun hangout with drinks, food and karaoke. Come in, make friends, party or just pretend to be Billy Madison for a while. All are welcome!

club.name: The Club
club.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York City A Joker-run casino parody where nobody wins money but everyone risks becoming part of the show. Play two games – Twenty One My Ass and Deez Roulette. Bring a joke, a story, or something strange with you. Welcome to a casino run by people who should not run casinos. Contact

unclelarrysmisguidedburners.name: Uncle Larry's Misguided Burners
unclelarrysmisguidedburners.description: We are the Misguided Burners of Uncle Larry! Home of KART Radio on 88.3FM! Taste a home-brew while getting weird on the streets of BRC!

sconefucker.name: Camp Scone Fucker
sconefucker.description: Come get Sconed with us. 9 unique flavors to try throughout the week and ice cold tea to wash it down. All while grooving to our camp DJs R & B, House, Rock, and Lo-Fi beats.

teapunk.name: Camp TeaPunk
teapunk.description: Stop by our Steampunk inspired tea/coffee/cocktail tent and chill for a bit. With victorian furniture, plush rugs, a cuddle puddle, small library and games you're sure to feel welcome as you prop your feet up and relax. Looking for something more upbeat? Our "Teabag Olympics" might be for you. With relay races in high heals, granny panty competitions and other hilarious happenings, you're sure to

vivarium.name: Vivarium
vivarium.description: 3SP (Third Space Place) is your dusty, comfy front porch/living room combo serving as a Black Rock City "third space" — a relaxing, community spot offering a real sense of welcome and belonging beyond one's dwelling ("first space") and one's workplace ("second space"). As with any true third space, guests can stop by, relax, ask for directions, chat, or PARTICIPATE in one of 3SP's events focusing

sweatybetty.name: Camp Sweaty Betty
sweatybetty.description: Friendly neighborhood misting Parlor, Hair Salon and Bike Repair. Stop in and experience an overall cooling sensation from head to foot as you stroll through the mist. Got crunchy hair, feeling a bit beat... Get in early for a partner provided hair wash. Got a flat, derailleur doesn't work, chain broke, we can fix that also. Misting & Bike Repair = Open 11:00 to 4:00. Bike Repair = DIY Service 10:

nomdeplume.name: Nom De Plume
nomdeplume.description: We are a tea lounge that has yerba mate brewing the entire event. Come by to lurk, chill, and lounge. Relax while thriving, and drinking tea. The way life should be. We have a variety of other teas available throughout the week but always have yerba brewing. Sit down and hydrate while you start or finish your day. Yerba Mate Dub starts every day at 10:30am. Classic dub sounds from around the world

blackrockyachtclub.name: Black Rock Yacht Club
blackrockyachtclub.description: We share our love of sailing by offering instruction, and use of our fleet of wind-powered rigs

starfist.name: StarFist
starfist.description: StarFist's infamous international tea service. Mon-Sat 2-5pm – serving a delightful selection of hot and cold infusions from around the world as we pamper and delight our guests. Offering a refuge from heat and dust, unparalleled hospitality and secret surprises for the lucky few. Morning meditation/yoga sessions most days at 11:11am and our fascinating evening StarFist Lecture Series, exploring a

honkersharbor.name: Honkers Harbor
honkersharbor.description: Calling all curious birds, wayward wings, and soulful squawkers— If you've been flying solo or searching for your flock, Honkers Harbor might just be your next nest. We're a neighborhood sanctuary for all species of seekers, honkers, and high-flyers. Perch beneath a canopy of fluttering fabrics and glowing lights. Sip on a hydrating refreshment or a snow cone while soaking in a soundscape that's e

deliciosoandcreperie.name: Camp Delicioso & Creperie
deliciosoandcreperie.description: Hungry! Hung over? You've been hankerin' for something warm in your belly? Swing on by Camp Delicioso and Crêperie, where you'll find an International collective of foodies who'll entertain and serve you the best damn OG French crêpe in Black Rock City. bytethis.name: Camp Byte This
bytethis.description: BYTE is a fully immersive art experience featuring two furry and lovable robots named "Chip" and “Terra". Camp Byte This is BYTE's offurcial fluffy camp that welcomes everybody! Swing by to check out our new mutant vehicle and furiend "Petabyte", get some beautifully designed BYTE gifties, grab one of our special cocktails, dance your dusty butts off to any one of our exceptionally gifted music ar

wwit.name: Camp Wwit
wwit.description: CAMPWWIT is place to ask yourself the question, "Wait, What's In This?" We explore the playa experience through snarky reflection, encouraging internal monologue and external dialogue through games, drinks, and music. With everything going on during the burn, we hope you can reflect on what's going on inside you with others to help bring these playa lessons out into the default world!

brcskiresort.name: BRC Ski Resort
brcskiresort.description: With great powder comes great responsibility. Black Rock City Ski Resort's EXTRAterrestrial hosts welcome all earthlings to join us for in the apres-ski experience of a lifetime. Send it on the dance floor with Frosty the Snowman Discoball and our iconic DJs, kick it and recharge in our luxurious hexayurt lounge, and get toasty at Starfucks coffee bar with the playa's finest cold brew and shot-ski

scotchandhop.name: Scotch & Hop
scotchandhop.description: Oh My Fur & Whiskers! You're late! You're late, for a very important date! Come follow the White Rabbit into our garden, where you can journey down a whimsical Acculturation Path with glowing & mesmerizing flowers & sparkly things. blazingdeathship.name: Blazing Death Ship
blazingdeathship.description: Join the legendary Death Ship at its home camp, where an interdimensional Viking feast hall awaits weary travelers. Join us for libations and savor slow-cooked dead animal at dusk-ish, Tuesday and Thursday, or just ride with us out on playa.

someplacecozy.name: Someplace Cozy
someplacecozy.description: Someplace Cozy offers a restorative sanctuary to the citizens of Black Rock City. Join us for iced tea, then wander into our cozy space for mindful relaxation, mental and physical recovery, chill beats, and deep conversations. gutter.name: The Gutter
gutter.description: Welcome to The Gutter, your grungy nostalgic neighborhood bowling alley. Land marked by our towering 10-ft bowling pin, The Gutter features a two-lane bowling alley open daily for spontaneous games, wild strikes, and the occasional gutterball. metalmimi.name: METAL MIMI Camp
metalmimi.description: Metal Mimi, the curious little creature who is our namesake, dwells at the Bay Area Metal Shop where Art Destined for the Playa is Born. Metal Mimi is Witness to Art made Manifest and she is the Keeper of our Magical Dreams. Metal Mimi Camp was created in honor of the Metal Workers, Welders, and Artists who work to bring their Art to the Dust. We are here to help them.

deathguildthunderdont.name: Death Guild Thunderdon't
deathguildthunderdont.description: Hometown: Oakland, California Have you seen our dome? We haven’t. Contact

kampkaos.name: Kamp Kaos
kampkaos.description: Celebrating all that is chaotic! KAOS campers hail from across the US. We celebrate curious minds, artists, engineers, makers, and anyone with an open mind. We bring something new every year!

parlourroom.name: The Parlour Room
parlourroom.description: The Parlour Room is a classy-not-classy, heavily shady/shaded, industrial Victorian lounge space welcoming all BRC citizens to come relax under the shade with a cool beverage during the morning and afternoon or chat the night's adventures fantastic around our fire pit in the wee hours.

elementum.name: Elementum
elementum.description: Earth. Air. Water. Fire. The place to nurture your nature. Experience the balance and amplification of the four elements through yoga, workshops, sound, and dance parties. We offer a non-alcoholic bar serving matcha & elemental elixirs daily. We provide flow, connection, and restoration for people of all identities and points of view. Home of the Space Cow People and the MIDNIGHT INFERNO PARTY on

happyhairsalon.name: Happy Hair Salon
happyhairsalon.description: Happy Hair Salon is a transformational hair salon where we showcase hair extensions as performance art. We offer hair extension makeovers, rave braids, beard braids, bubble braids and the like while serving snow cones and offering shade and relaxation in our antigravity chairs. Burnt out? Playafied beyond belief? Come to Happy Hair and we will help you get your groove back, but this time even bett

wanderlust.name: Wanderlust
wanderlust.description: Welcome to our Moroccan Themed Oasis in the Desert. Come join us for our fun activities. We look forward to seeing you on the Playa!!!

gallavant.name: Gallavant
gallavant.description: Ahoy from the Pirates of the Playa (infamous creators of the oldest pirate ship on the playa the USS Nevada)…look for us "Gallavanting" around the playa spreading fun and adventure and hop a ride with us! ! Our mighty USS Nevada will be doing 2+ tours around playa daily from our home port so come visit us, enjoy our signature grogs concocted with rum in an awesome full-fledged pirate bar, The Arrg

spacecowboys.name: Space Cowboys
spacecowboys.description: Shakin Yo Business again on the Playa! The cowgirls and cowboys are back yet again with their version of the Wild West. Travel the playa on the Martha - An Art Car with Love & personality. Martha < 3's you! An experience to the edge of the playa. playground.name: Playground
playground.description: Playground is an oasis for the intrepid burner crossing the vast expanse of BRC. Filled with sights, sounds and music, Playground will entrance and delight with fun, fire and dance!
playground.instagram_note: Belongs to the Playground Foundation (Carl Cox org), not BRC-camp-specific — feed carries non-BM content.

hashhouse.name: The Hash House
hashhouse.description: The Black Rock City Hash House Harriers are a group of hashers from around the world that come together to share our love of drinking, singing, sometimes running, and shenanigans with everyone at Burning Man. Join us for a hash on the playa. In addition to our Annual Red Dress Run (Thursday, 3pm, meet at the man), we host a variety of hash activities and events. Check out our events page for more

blackrockcitypassportoffice.name: Black Rock City Passport Office
blackrockcitypassportoffice.description: Your adventure awaits! Explore Black Rock City! Record your journey! We provide playa passports you can get stamped at various camps to record your travels. Visit your favorite camps and discover new ones!
blackrockcitypassportoffice.instagram_display_name: The Black Rock City Passport Office

retrofrolic.name: Retrofrolic
retrofrolic.description: Retrofrolic is an adult destination offering multiple features. ☆ A 2100 sq ft supervised public dungeon playspace ☆ A 2000 sq ft public shade porch. ☆ A suspension point between our twin-towers for flying pole, Lyra, yoga silks or Shibari demos. ☆ Morning coffee with Mayor Angus ☆ Daily class to explore your sensual and sexual desires. ☆ Learn sane and safe play. ☆ Get that heretofore unanswered

paralunatics.name: Paralunatics
paralunatics.description: Paraluna is the camp where the people who run http://ledlabs.co/paraluna live!

livelaughlovelounge.name: Live Laugh Love Lounge
livelaughlovelounge.description: Step into a dreamlike grove where color-shifting light, ambient sound, and organic textures invite moments of pause and inner reflection. This immersive space blends bioluminescent-inspired art with mindful programming—offering glow-paint workshops, quiet meditations, and evening sound journeys under soft, shifting hues. artsupportforbasssnail.name: Art Support for Bass Snail
artsupportforbasssnail.description: Hometown: Boise Welcome to the high-desert hub for the Bass Snail Mutant Vehicle and the Idaho Conclave. Located at the intersection of heavy machinery and flow arts, our camp is a vibrant gateway for the Idaho creative community. When the Bass Snail is docked, visitors can explore the art car, meet the builders, and collect commemorative stickers and patches. Seeking a break from the dust? Relax

sluttymicrophone.name: Slutty Microphone
sluttymicrophone.description: Camp Slutty Microphone provides an open mic stage that hosts guest live music performances 24/7. Our stage includes a shared keyboard, drum kit, guitar, and a few other instruments. Bands are welcome!

musecaf.name: MUSE Café
musecaf.description: MUSE Café is a nod, a wink, a slap on the bum. It's a toast to the muse in you and the muse in me. Its booty shaking praise and it's champagne smiles. It is a place to embrace both the funky and meaningful in a "come as you are" kinda way. Our goal is to honor & celebrate the inspiration in every human being. templeoflyingspaghettimonster.name: Temple O'Flying Spaghetti Monster
templeoflyingspaghettimonster.description: We are a comfortable neighborhood pub with a-rockin' attitude and groovin' tunes. In honor of His Noodly Goodness, the Friendly Fire Bar will administer ice-cold libations for your mind, body, and spirit. rumisteahouse.name: Rumi's Tea House
rumisteahouse.description: We serve tea, occasionally, and good vibes, always.

sultrylodge.name: The Sultry Lodge
sultrylodge.description: A sultry crowd from 3 continents! * Get your hair braided with colorful extensions at the start of the week. * Enjoy a sultry breakfast mid-week. * Jewelry making facilities. * Everybody's Birthday Party. It's for you – after all, you are born someday too! And every night: A stunning Interactive UV-active Art exhibition. Come for the art and enjoy the sultry company!

preservationsociety.name: Preservation Society
preservationsociety.description: Preservation Society: Preserving what has been lost. Our luscious green garden is your oasis in the desert. Our events refresh you with music and dance. Our bar serves potent potables with preserves from all the corners of the world from which our camp hails.

glamcocks.name: Glamcocks
glamcocks.description: GlamCocks is a global family that was started at Burning Man, and is dedicated to creating extraordinary experiences that celebrate and encourage burner principles, GlamCockery, bringing people together to find inspiration and creativity, and to express their fabulous, authentic selves. We believe that creativity, authenticity, and love for yourself and others are critical to having meaningful con

brcsnowclub.name: BRC Snow Club
brcsnowclub.description: Welcome shredders! BRCSC is the home of the first (and only) ski slope on the Playa! Come get outfitted for boots and skis or a board in our Rental Shop, then ascend the slope to rip down our 60-foot long, multi-tiered dry ski hill! Don't ski or snowboard, no problem! We'll have saucers aplenty for shredders of all ages to come and fly down the slope! Also hosting nightly Après Ski parties with ph

omskillet.name: Om Skillet
omskillet.description: Om Skillet - serving the playa Gourmet Grilled Cheese lunches Monday through Thursday and hosting the Short Stack TuTu Tuesday dance party at 2:22pm on Tuesday since 2011.

petaledportal.name: Petaled Portal
petaledportal.description: Hometown: Ventura We are an Art Support Camp for Petaled Portal, a stained glass mosaic on playa.

luciddreamhideout.name: Lucid Dream Hideout
luciddreamhideout.description: A afternoon coffee bar to get the best iced coffee and Matcha on the Playa! We have a live DJ, wi-fi and shade to sit and chill to share your amazing burner stories. Spin our Wheel of Misfortune for a fun experience and receive a memorable sticker to remember your amazing time with us!

vault21.name: Vault 21+
vault21.description: Vault 21+ invites you to step into our 23-hour-a-day dive bar—that's right, 23 hours. If you're roaming the wasteland and thirsting for a drink, there's a good chance we're open… unless it's sunrise. In that case, take a moment to soak in the irradiated sunrise, then return when the time is right. We'll still be here, with a cold drink waiting for you. This week, we've got a killer lineup of event

sofarsogood.name: So Far So Good
sofarsogood.description: Try your skill at BRC's best mini golf course. Come as your are or round up a team to compete!

Think Marie Antoinette but in the Wild West. A place where you can never have too many cows or cow puns. At high noon be udderly refreshed by dairy-alternative craft cocktails at our bar, The Tits, and spend some time in the shade nourishing your connections at our me

seemtoleave.name: Camp Seem to Leave
seemtoleave.description: Hometown: San Francisco Your sticky home away from home. We humbly welcome you, and the dusty pile of tetanus you rode in on. Drop by for a life-changing cocktail & leave with a side quest. Contact

myfavoritethings.name: My Favorite Things
myfavoritethings.description: At My Favorite Things, we're all about creating unforgettable experiences and fostering community spirit through an array of interactive activities and experiences we love. As you explore our camp, you'll discover a plethora of exciting offerings designed to keep you cool, entertained, and connected: a cacao ceremony to connect with the spirit of ancestors, an aerial arts workshop, playa dust scul

drinkanddrivein.name: Drink and Drive-In
drinkanddrivein.description: Hometown: Reno At our camp we condone drinking and driving-in to enjoy a movie and a drink with us! We have chairs, and games, and whit. If you’ve got nothing else to do, and you’ve had a few too many, PULL UP.

nipplecrime.name: Nipple Crime
nipplecrime.description: Nipple crime is a Reno based theme camp dedicated to memorable experiences. Come have a drink at our extensive home-brewed bar. Friday's Sensual Hotdog eating contest is our biggest event and won't disappoint. We are mostly a day camp but often have small parties well into the morning.

veniceredlight.name: Venice Red Light
veniceredlight.description: Inspired by the free-spirited heritage of our adopted home of Venice Beach, CA. We are a conglomerate of artists getting weird and supporting each other as we put our dreams into action.

shuttlecocks.name: Shuttlecocks
shuttlecocks.description: Welcome to Shuttlecocks, where we're bringing Badminton back. Our playa court is open by noon into the evening from Tuesday to Friday for pick up play. Come on by, grab a racquet and have a go! Don't miss our Tuesday BADminton cheeky happy hour and Friday afternoon tournament where you can challenge your fellow burners. Whether you're showing off your killer smash, whacking a few birdies, or relax

jailofhedone.name: Jail of Hedone
jailofhedone.description: A large Old Western wooden-fronted enclosed space with air conditioning & cooling misters. This JAIL evokes Hedone, the Goddess of Sensual Pleasure and so, is stocked with cots, giant pillows and couches; snacks, water, cold beer & drinks (including our signature Absinthe-Whiskey craft cocktail) along with a stripper pole, whips & ticklers, great music, the occasional foot bath, along with sporty

kidsville.name: Kidsville
kidsville.description: Burning Man's best place for kids! Come enjoy our trampolines, playgrounds, kid-friendly treats, and meet other families that burn with people under 18.

vietnameseicedcoffeeexperience.name: Vietnamese Iced Coffee Experience
vietnameseicedcoffeeexperience.description: Vietnamese Iced Coffee Experience (VICE) is an all inclusive Burning Man Theme Camp offering a cool icy beverage during the heat of the day as well as several other activities for our fellow participants. We encourage diversity, participation, and acceptance and welcome new members from all locales and walks of life.

drawninn.name: Drawn Inn
drawninn.description: Drawn Inn is a studio space and lounge where you are both the artist, and the art. Come flex those artistic muscles at our Figure Drawing classes and even try your hand at being one of our models! We will have open studio hours. And, themed events where we offer whimsical props, body paint and creative atmosphere to help you become your most inspired self.

rabbithole.name: Rabbit Hole
rabbithole.description: It's whatever you want it to be!

dustandstars.name: dust & stars
dustandstars.description: WE WELCOME ALL WHO DARE. this is dust & star's eleventh year as a placed theme cult. that's right: we're a cult. since the dawn of us, we've donned black robes and warned other burners the endless night was on its way. to celebrate our 10th anniversary last year, we held a very special initiation ceremony on thursday night... AND THE ENDLESS NIGHT FINALLY ARRIVED. well... something did. maybe we g

maisonphi.name: Maison Phi
maisonphi.description: Hometown: New York City Maison Phi is your beautifully chaotic oasis in the dust where hydration, pancakes, yoga, and late-night dance floors all coexist in perfect imbalance. By day, come get revived at our Cucumber Water Station, reset with yoga, cool off with popsicles, or hang at our card games and pancake mornings. By evening, we serve up our iconic Dirty Chicken Martini Soup and roll out for

mystopia.name: Mystopia
mystopia.description: Step out of the sun-scorched wonderland into our cool haven. It's an icy oasis, an ice cream paradise, and a sanctuary for all. We welcome everyone: friends, partners, parents, children, individuals of any race, orientation and identity. Stop by our burner family and experience the rainbow of diversity. Come play with us, sit down and watch some drag/burlesque, dance with a stranger or simply rela

hotellobby.name: Hotel Lobby
hotellobby.description: With a lavish chandelier, bellhop service, concierge desk, a lux hotel bar, and a buzzing karaoke lounge, you'll be treated to 5-star service and a dusty bev in a welcoming and weird Hotel Lobby.

uddernonsense.name: Udder Nonsense
uddernonsense.description: Hometown: Tahoe Something mysterious has appeared on the playa. A herd of cows, extraterrestrial, or possibly escaped from Fly Ranch, has set up camp, and they want you. Come climb the Milk Tower for panoramic playa views, race mini cow RC cars through our obstacle course, or slip on a pair of cow headphones and lose yourself in the Moo Lounge Rouge silent discow experience. Three times this week

den.name: The Den
den.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Santa Cruz That magical place where you can explore fun and play, where you can connect deeply with a person and never see them again, where you can talk philosophy, politics, science… or just be horny! In the den, anything can happen if you want it to. Stop on by and hangout at our bar and sample our World Famous Love Puddle Punch, if you are lucky you may get a spanking from our Lov

religiousasfuck.name: Religious As Fuck
religiousasfuck.description: Camp Religious As Fuck provides decomodified and non-judgy Christian spiritual practice and hospitality.

8bitbunny.name: 8-bit Bunny
8bitbunny.description: Our steam sauna is open every day. Sweet out the dust and leave cleaner than you have ever been on playa. Feeling adventurous? Spin the wheel at our bar for a drink. Rabbit ears encouraged, but not required.

musemaenaduniversity.name: MUSE (Maenad University)
musemaenaduniversity.description: The Maenad University for the Study of the Esoteric (M.U.S.E.) is a tribute to the deity Dionyus and offers a temple space for offerings as well as for our interactivity which ranges from spiritual to silly. We offer a 24 hour labyrinth for visitors to use as well as a kiosk which will host a variety of camp run and visitor run interactivity. We are a very welcoming group and you are free to say h

illuminaughty.name: Illuminaughty
illuminaughty.description: Illuminate your naughty side! Come visit our naughty carnival Monday-Thursday 4PM-8PM! Challenge yourself to feats of great debauchery! Tuesday and Thursday, the carnival becomes a riotous party through midnight - just follow the bright lights of our Ball of Light, high in the sky. Come see the Aperiodic Wall, the entrancing optical illusion generator! Enjoy the Chill Room, keeping everyone cool d

blackrockacademy.name: Black Rock Academy
blackrockacademy.description: We are often approached at Camp Black Rock Academy with the question of, "So what do you guys teach?" Personally, I dont think the important question is, "What do you guys teach?" But rather, I would follow up with, "What are you willing to learn?"

itsonlynatural.name: It's Only Natural
itsonlynatural.description: Our camp offers a safe and inclusive environment for individuals wishing to participate in naturism. The space is fully enclosed, shielding participants from cell phones, cameras, and onlookers in the city. Inside, you will find a communal gathering area, with games, music, and a daily cocktail hour. We provide a friendly, non-sexualized setting for anyone wishing to experience nude recreation.

gspotandslothsinema.name: The G-Spot & Sloth Sinema
gspotandslothsinema.description: Can you find the G-Spot? We are your favorite neighborhood dive bar. Come thirsty, leave happy! New for 2024 we are shifting to an evening offering and opening the Sloth Sinema. Join us for a chill evening of great movies, themed cocktails, and of course, shenanigans! Family-friendly matinees included. Already have plans for the evening? Come by in the morning for "Saturday" morning cartoons and m

nativetongues.name: Native Tongues
nativetongues.description: A Native Tongue speaks to the frequency we all share, a common way of communicating with love, empathy & respect. An acknowledgment of the humanity we recognize in each other. And also a kick ass rap collective from the 90's!

owlandthepussycat.name: Owl and the Pussycat
owlandthepussycat.description: We are a small but mighty group of folx whose camp is a safe, welcoming environment for all Burners. We not only value physical comfort as seen by our cozy lounge and dining space, but emotional comfort to promote connection, conversation and reflection with our fellow Burners. We also value a good time! Come by our quiet Dream Hatchery lounge where you can take pause and meditate or join us for a

lastcampsitting.name: Last Camp Sitting
lastcampsitting.description: Hometown: San Francisco Is it a porto, is a portal? Only those who look closely will know! Contact

temple.name: Temple Camp
temple.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Oakland We are the support camp for Temple of the Moon, this year’s official Burning Man Temple. We are a multinational crew of artists, builders, creators and supporters who have spent all of 2026 bringing this temple to life for our community. We welcome everyone to stop by and learn more about the process of designing and building the temple, and we’d love to hear your thoughts and

ashackofsit.name: A Shack of Sit
ashackofsit.description: Do you feel like belting out a karaoke song or letting out your frustrations in our rage cage? Are you looking for a great spot to sit, grab some cold water, and watch the world go by while getting your nails painted, moisturizing your face, and enjoying a percussive massage? Are you looking for the Mensa Camp? Come visit A Shack of Sit; where sit happens. We will be waiting for you in Snowflake V

picklebackmountain.name: PickleBack Mountain
picklebackmountain.description: Come by and enjoy our homemade Pickle Back Juice at our Pickle Back Bar. Come through our Saloon Doors in Space, mosey on up to bar, throw down a Pickle Back! Then, for the daring, jump on Gherkin our famous Bucking Pickle for the buck of your life!

playapianobarandlounge.name: Playa Piano Bar and Lounge
playapianobarandlounge.description: Playa Piano Bar and Lounge will be featuring live collaborative musical performance along with refreshing beverages every afternoon except Friday. Come by Tuesday for Tutu Tuesday Evening Music Party and Tacos from 6 to 8 Come by Wednesday For Pizza Pockets and Music from 6 to 8 Drinks and music every afternoon Monday to Thursday 3 to 5

newdesertoutpost.name: New Desert Outpost
newdesertoutpost.description: We are an eclectic, antique outpost for wanderers and those seeking adventure.

stimulationstation.name: Stimulation Station
stimulationstation.description: Most of what we learn from the world around us is due to perception, cognition and activities are mediated through vision. SO what happens if we take away sight and focus on other stimulations like touch, sound and smell? Come check out Stimulation Station, service of soothing touch, peaceful sounds and beautiful senses M-F 12pm-3pm or just come by to hang out in our lounge any time!

aandmpersand.name: A&mpersand
aandmpersand.description: Need a respite from the heat of the playa? Camp "&" invites you to come enjoy our shave ice, spam musubi and more at our Hawaii themed afternoon events.

wokpaperscissors.name: Wok Paper Scissors
wokpaperscissors.description: Welcome to Wok Paper Scissors! Here in Sizzle City you battle for your stir fry. Come one, come all to Wok Paper Scissors, serving stir fry on the playa daily. To get your hands on a bowl of our delicious delights, you must first win a game of rock-paper-scissors! Do you have what it takes when noodles are at stake?

moonlightcollective.name: Moonlight Collective
moonlightcollective.description: We are the art support camp building the Moonlight Library. Come visit our camp to meet the artists, and enjoy some hot sake at our sake bar.

parley.name: Parley
parley.description: Parley is your dedicated conversation camp. Come "Parley" with us during our daily facilitated events or drop in anytime for adhoc conversations on your topic of your choice. Our mission is to facilitate meaningful conversations and bridge gaps between people who might be different from one another. The topics and framing are done in a way that everyone can have an opinion and a voice. During the

picklejoint.name: Pickle Joint
picklejoint.description: Downtown Black Rock City's favorite magical little hole in the wall. Serving our world famous Pickle-Tini Cocktail since… errp… too long. Let's say well over a decade. Always a sumptuous groove on our dance floor….or maybe a Led Zeppelin Kazoo orchestra.

squareone.name: Square One
squareone.description: A diverse group united in creating large-scale art through efficient and sustainable designs, inspiring individuals and other camps to burn stronger. Our efficiency-driven approach allows us to contribute more to the community. playacircuitboogie.name: Playa Circuit Boogie
playacircuitboogie.description: Here at Playa Circuit Boogie we use circuits and science to spark ideas and bring strangers together, all while jamming out to groovy tunes and enjoying a cold beverage from our bar. Come learn the basics of soldering and circuit building; ride away with your very own light-up pendant and the skills to make an even better one next year. And bring us your broken electronics during repair hours, we'

hookahdome.name: Hookahdome
hookahdome.description: Enter our silk draped, plush, cushioned, lantern-lit, air-conditioned dome to be whisked away into an oasis from the dust and heat. Let our loving attendants ensure your comfort while we serve you house made organic shisha and tea. Be entertained by a variety of intimate world music and dance performances taking place on the center carpet. Wednesday-Sunday evenings, our outdoor courtyard, illumina

aahwonder.name: Aah Wonder
aahwonder.description: Aah Wonder Camp offers a sampling of savory and sweet round tasty bites and beverages inspired by our members' favorite experiences traveling around the world. While waiting for your fresh off the griddle treat, step into our shaded lounge space with rugs, pillows, and cool mist fans. There, you can relax and enjoy connecting with new people and playing conversational and hands-on games. All ages

safari.name: Camp Safari
safari.description: Determine your fate with a spin of the Safari Wheel. Photo ops, animal hunts, and other dusty games

atransformationstation.name: A Transformation Station
atransformationstation.description: Explore, Engage, Evolve: Transformation Amidst the Magic of Burning Man. Discover a world where transformative experiences and interactive art merge to create a sanctuary of healing, reflection, and communal celebration. Dive into classes or workshops during the day, sign up for 1-1 healings, and co-create collective narratives that envision a future of interconnectedness and environmental conscio

shoturanga.name: Shoturanga
shoturanga.description: Embrace unknown probabilities and explore universal truths by rolling the dice, allowing fate and magic to intertwine in a dance of chance. Each roll serves as a conduit for the universe's will, guiding you toward unique and spontaneous experiences and connections. mystic.name: Mystic
mystic.hometown: Bay Area + Los Angeles CA + Denver, CO + New York, NY
mystic.description: Mystic is a legacy theme camp with a rich 20+ year history in Black Rock City. We create a vibrant space filled with interactive art, uplifting music, and transformative workshops that inspire personal growth and connection. cave.name: The Cave
cave.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco To deviate positively is to play with the rules, reimagine the future, build new realities, and break what no longer serves. It starts small: a question, an experiment, a new way of relating – that quietly reorganizes what’s possible between us and around us.

institute.name: The Institute
institute.description: The Institute of higher yearning invites the dusty wanderer to expand their mind into the bottomless pit of knowledge and exploration.

lunardisco.name: Lunar Disco
lunardisco.description: Embrace the cosmic elements in our electrifying dance and party spaces, with interstellar beats and mesmerizing ambience. Connect with fellow stargazers in our ceremonial space, honoring the celestial bodies and the shared human experience. Embark on an otherworldly adventure at Lunar Disco.

havananights.name: Havana Nights
havananights.description: Experience the essence of a vibrant Latin dance party infused with the relaxed vibe of Miami. Encircled by palm trees, our spacious, shaded dance floor beckons. Relax on our plush, elevated chill pads or sway in hammocks. Savor the night with bottomless, hand-muddled frozen mojitos served by attendants in traditional guayabera shirts as world-class DJs deliver an electrifying mix of Cuban and Lati

fauxliage.name: Fauxliage
fauxliage.description: Our fake greenhouse offers a temporary refuge from the harsher elements of the playa. Come take a break in our cool space, have some tea, and practice your creativity by making origami playa gifts. We'll hang leftover origami pieces throughout the week as if our greenhouse is "growing" in the desert! At night, look for our 11' LED sign, colorful up lights, silhouetted plants, and occasional fire s

blackrocktravelagency.name: Black Rock Travel Agency
blackrocktravelagency.description: The Black Rock Travel Agency is a gang of pilots, aviation enthusiasts, and adventurers who come together every year to serve the airport village and its visitors located at the end of Point5. Yes, there is an airport! BRTA makes it just like you imagine a Burning Man Airport would be. A massive Starport pyramid structure with entertainment and bar underneath with 30 foot viewing platform above? Y

readyplayaone.name: Ready Playa One
readyplayaone.description: Ready Playa One - a world that we dream up, believe in, and step curiously into, together in Black Rock City. Each day is an adventure to expand our minds, deepen human connection, and creatively challenge the status quo's of the world that we believe in changing.

fountainofyouth.name: The Fountain (of youth)
fountainofyouth.description: The Fountain (of youth) is a longevity-focused camp at BM where we celebrate life and coordinate to fight aging & death. Our gifts to the playa are LongeviTEA, our signature teahouse and the Rejuvenating IV Lounge. yellowballoon.name: Yellow Balloon
yellowballoon.description: Yellow Balloon is a clean and sober camp at Burning Man, offering a space for fun, connection, and wellness without the influence of substances. We host daily recovery meetings, wellness events like yoga and breathwork, and interactive art experiences designed to uplift and engage. Our camp is a vibrant community of burners who love to have a great time while staying sober throughout the burn. We

drcarlscollectionofdepts.name: Dr. Carl's Collection of Depts.
drcarlscollectionofdepts.description: Dr. Carl's Collection of Departments returns! Come play our legendary Dept. of Collections game, where we will give you a semi-fabulous prize if you can do, are, or tell us about a thing we list on the board of tiles. fundobar.name: Fun-do Bar
fundobar.description: Looking to get melty while having a booty shaking good time?! Look no further than Fun-Do Bar! Our delicious Swiss cheese and chocolate fondue paired with ice cold wine is sure to make your taste buds dance! Join us for our dance party happy hour (4p-6p or until we run out!). helioz.name: Helioz
helioz.description: At Helioz, we worship the Sun god. To honor our god, we roast delicious animals and share them with all guests. Come by in the late afternoon and evening for some tasty treats, and drink a sun-god libation.

dreamery.name: Dreamery
dreamery.hometown: Laguna Niguel, Irvine, San Diego, Kiev
dreamery.description: Dreamery is a camp to discover, share and experience dreams. It is an interactive space to read and write dreams and fantasies, happy or scary, random and crazy, sensual or sad. What dream would you ask for if you could? If you could go anywhere in a dream, where would it be? At Dreamery, you might also meet someone special. You can see if you want to hang out for just a bit or maybe become lifelo

serenitynow.name: Serenity Now
serenitynow.description: An oasis in a world of dust. Serenity Now is a long standing coffee house and performance space, with cold brew coffee service, featuring art and music.

giantsworkshopsaloon.name: Giants Workshop Saloon
giantsworkshopsaloon.description: Hometown: Hudson Valley We could be anything—including a dusty saloon run by Giants, come by for our nightly Sunset Socials for a variety of offerings of music, food, and drinks! Our saloon doors are open 24 hours, stop by anytime to see if the bar is open or just to rest your weary boots. A variety of workshops will be happening throughout the week, roll on through and see what we’re up to!

liquidspankuary.name: Liquid Spankuary
liquidspankuary.description: Great music, Great Mead, party games, dancing, and general shenanigans. We make janky look good!

hardasarock.name: Hard as a Rock
hardasarock.description: A rag-tag bunch of geologists with a passion for sharing geology - including the geology of the Black Rock Desert! Join our geologists for rock talks, get creative with rock painting. Dig up your best rock puns and strike fools gold and other rockin' gifts!

cocoonsociety.name: Cocoon Society
cocoonsociety.description: Hometown: Anaheim A new theme camp operating within the Imagimorphia hub, a returning art support camp. The hub operates under a shared frontage with the Imagimorphia name, and Cocoon Society contributes a transformation-centered public ritual experience as its core offering: the Vinyl Ritual. Participants enter a softened ambient sound environment, choose from pre-made mandala or word/phrase viny

beatsndeets.name: Beats 'n Deets
beatsndeets.description: Don't lose your shit when you lose your shit. Label it first at Beats 'n Deets. We make labels for all your stuff with a mug shot style photo with you and your camp details on it making it easy for people to return it to you or easy to find at lost and found. And it's a great souvenir. Come join us for drinks, specialised in NA drinks, in our circus tent with animated projections on the wall and s

baggagecheck.name: Baggage Check
baggagecheck.description: Check your Emotional Baggage with us. Spend Time Today to create a Better Tommorow for yourself! By writing down your emotional baggage you don't have to carry it with you; use that freed up emotional headspace to cultivate and connect with your future! We'll turn your emotional baggage into ashes and celebrate your newfound self-actualization at the temple burn. Stop by any time of the day or nig

argonauts.name: Argonauts
argonauts.description: Cherish the uncertain, challenge fear, welcome the odd, and seek thyself! The Argonauts bring a unique and infectious spirit which we share across the playa and in conjunction with reenergizing camp activities including our high-noon ArgoDogs and ArgoShine-enhanced induction ceremonies. Besides our Argonaut spirit and noontime hot dogs, our gifts include Argonaut dust, sun & fashion bandanas, temp

bumblepuss.name: Bumblepuss
bumblepuss.description: Bumblepuss brings a spa theme to the playa with the addition of the aromatherapy focused Lavender Lounge. Visit and soak in the aromas while you relax in the shade after your Steam Bath from our sister camp.

longfeng.name: Long Feng Camp
longfeng.description: Hometown: Los Angeles Long Feng Sound Camp is a living, breathing immersive soundscape where East meets West in rhythm, ritual, and release. By day, it hums with connection. By night, it ignites. A precision-tuned sound stage draws you into a field of movement and awe, while the Xiao Long Night Market unfolds nearby – a Chinatown dream woven with delights to tickle the senses including games, tea,

roadsidedistraction.name: Roadside Distraction
roadsidedistraction.description: Roll up for a hub of spectacular sidetracks and childlike wonder! Give it your all to set a record for "Most Clothespins Pinned to the Face in One Minute", "Speed Kissing", or "Most Leapfrogs in 30 Seconds". With renowned carnival games and attractions in our Chamber of Wonders, including the soul-searching experience of Burning Man's Darkest Room, the mesmerizing optical illusions and sensory del

stampede.name: Stampede!
stampede.description: Hometown: Phoenix A movement and connection-driven space inviting you off your bike and into the herd. Step into a shaded lounge for yoga, breathwork, and playful, consent-forward interaction. Explore aerial, join spontaneous group moments, or simply land and connect. Come find your stripes. Contact

DJs/Producers showcase their music through a sound system that produces frequencies which are not just heard, but deeply felt. opulenttemple.name: Opulent Temple
opulenttemple.description: Opulent Chill, a sanctuary for chill music, shade, connection and conversation.

entheoscommunity.name: Entheos Community Village
entheoscommunity.description: Members of the Entheos Community organize one of the larger and most diverse theme camps placed at the annual Burning Man event in the Black Rock Desert of Nevada. Friends and members of the Entheos Community come from over 43 countries to contribute their effort, skills, and resources to the creation of Entheos @ Burning Man. The camp creates extensive 24/7 interactivity for all ages as a gift to

peopleofcolor.name: People of Color Camp
peopleofcolor.description: Bringing COLOR to the playa since 2014! The People of Color Camp is what happens when The Muppet Show gets put in the same telepod as an episode of The Fresh Prince of Bel Air, MTV's The Real World and a debate at the United Nations. We provide opportunity for BIPOC Burners to not only learn about and experience Burning Man, but make it our home. We bring the diversity of our cultures to the playa

bistromanonio.name: Bistro Manonio
bistromanonio.description: Hometown: Marseille Step inside a small desert bistro where strangers gather around a circular communal table inside a handmade geodesic dome. Inspired by French and Polish traditions, we share simple rustic food, warm drinks, and good conversation with curious wanderers who stop by. renonation.description: Biggest Little Shit Show On The Playa Great beer; Weird People Welcome to the Shit-Rock Saloon!

rubberarmstrong.description: For everything bad, Mezcal, for everything that is good as well, and if it still does not help, one and a half liters. We are a diverse solar powered camp made up of members from all over the world all sharing a love of Mezcal. Come join us for a delicious sunset Margie.

playadelicaciescookingschool.description: Playa Delicacies cooking school is an interactive learning experience

saintsandsinners.name: Saints and Sinners
saintsandsinners.description: A welcoming and laid-back camp within Silicon Village, where most mornings are dedicated to family-friendly button making. As dusk approaches, our camp takes on a "sinnery" vibe, lighting up the street with a red glow. Our street-side shade structure is a hub of activity throughout the day, with someone always ready to greet you. Feel free to swing by and say hi!

discospaceshuttle.name: Disco Space Shuttle

global.name: Global Camp
global.description: Global Camp exists to be a safe place for international participants, and our camp every year has over 30 regions or more represented. Come and hang out with us - and enjoy wellness offerings Tuesday to Friday mornings and afternoons.

soundgarden.name: The Sound Garden

instagram_verify_method: bin/ig-verify.sh — fetch instagram.com/<handle> with a GOOGLEBOT user-agent. IG blocks normal fetches (any handle returns 200 + empty) but still renders og:title and og:description for Googlebot, giving the real display name + follower/post counts. An invented handle returns NO og data at all. Verified working 2026-08-25 against a deliberately fake handle. This rejected 4 plausible wrong answers that would have silently poisoned the pipeline.
instagram_scrape_trap: Ignore instagram.com/squarespace — Squarespace sites (lotusdome.net, campsoftlanding.co) keep the factory placeholder in their social block. A naive grep reads it as the camp's handle.
